paras.zh: 他们失控地横冲直撞，行程远不平稳——毕竟才初秋，地面刚刚硬到能让橇刃滑行。

paras.en: Any other sleigh would not have been able to make it across the rough terrain of scrub, brush, and rock, but an Elsa-made sleigh was as slippery as could be, and twice as fast.
paras.zh: 换了别的雪橇，绝不可能越过这灌木、矮丛与岩石交错的崎岖地形，可艾莎造的雪橇滑得不能再滑，还快了一倍。

paras.en: Another vial of powder whistled by Anna’s ear, and she turned her head just before violet fire could engulf her.
paras.zh: 又一个小瓶的粉末从安娜耳边呼啸而过，她偏过头，紫色的火才没能吞没她。

paras.en: From the corner of her eye, she saw Elsa raise her hands. “No!” Anna yelled. “You can’t!
paras.zh: 眼角余光里，她看见艾莎举起了双手。“不！”安娜喊道，“你不能！

paras.en: The Nattmara will only get bigger and more powerful!” Elsa lowered her hands, and Anna faced forward. “What’s that?” Anna asked, pointing at a dark line in the earth that loomed ahead. “That,” Kristoff said with a gulp, “is a canyon.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉只会变得更大更强！”艾莎放下手，安娜转回前方。“那是什么？”安娜指着前方地平线上一道黑色的线问。“那个，”克里斯托夫咽了口唾沫说，“是峡谷。

paras.en: A very, very, very wide canyon.” Another whistle hit the air.
paras.zh: 一道非常、非常、非常宽的峡谷。”又一声呼啸划破空气。

paras.en: Another blast. “We have to lose it!” Anna yelled. “Faster!
paras.zh: 又一声爆响。“我们得甩掉它！”安娜喊，“再快！

paras.en: Faster!
paras.zh: 再快！

paras.en: We’ll be able to clear the canyon!” “No, we won’t!” Elsa shouted. “We’re too heavy!” The dark line was thicker now, the chasm closer and wider.
paras.zh: 我们能跃过峡谷的！”“不，我们跃不过去！”艾莎喊，“我们太重了！”那道黑线更粗了，深渊更近也更宽。

paras.en: Just a few more seconds until they would be able to try to clear it, to try to soar over the deep trench. “Elsa, here!” Kristoff thrust the reins into Elsa’s hands before turning to Anna. “I think I can hold Sorenson off until sunset,” he said, looking straight into her eyes. “Tell Sven I said he should listen to you.” His words came too fast, and the meaning came too slow.
paras.zh: 再过几秒，他们就能试着跃过它，试着飞越这道深沟。“艾莎，接住！”克里斯托夫把缰绳塞进艾莎手里，转身面向安娜。“我想我能拖住索伦森，直到日落，”他直视她的眼睛说，“告诉斯文，我说过他该听你的。”他的话说得太快，意思却来得太平。

paras.en: Anna shook her head. “Wait, what?” But then Kristoff was kissing her.
paras.zh: 安娜摇着头。“等等，什么？”可下一刻，克里斯托夫吻上了她。

paras.en: His lips pressed to hers, warm and light and as strong as a promise…but a promise for what?
paras.zh: 他的唇贴上她的，温暖而轻柔，又如承诺般坚定……可这承诺，是为着什么？

paras.en: Before Anna could gather up her thoughts and piece together what he was telling her, her lips were suddenly cold again.
paras.zh: 安娜还没来得及理清思绪、拼出他想说的话，她的唇忽然又变冷了。

paras.en: The kiss, over.
paras.zh: 一吻结束。

paras.en: And Kristoff was turning away from her, balancing on the edge of the sleigh… “No!” Anna gasped as his words became clear.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫正从她身边转开，在雪橇边缘稳住身形……“不！”当他的话变得清晰，安娜倒抽一口凉气。

paras.en: But she was too late.
paras.zh: 可她已经太迟了。

paras.en: Kristoff leapt from the sleigh, and Anna screamed. “What’s happening?” Elsa yelled, tearing her eyes from the chasm and looking back just as Kristoff landed hard on the ground, both knees bending to absorb the impact, somehow managing to stay on his feet.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫跃出雪橇，安娜尖叫起来。“怎么了？”艾莎喊，目光从深渊移开，回头的刹那正看见克里斯托夫重重落地，双膝弯屈卸去冲击，竟奇迹般站稳了。

paras.en: And then he was off, running toward Sorenson. “KRISTOFF!” Anna shouted.
paras.zh: 接着他撒开腿，朝索伦森跑去。“克里斯托夫！”安娜喊。

paras.en: But without his added weight, the sleigh slipped faster.
paras.zh: 可没了他的重量，雪橇滑得更快了。

paras.en: The bear’s heavy paws sent mud flying as he barreled his way toward the chasm, taking Anna farther and farther from Kristoff. “KRISTOFF!” Anna shouted again. “KRISTOFF, COME BACK!” But Sorenson had seen him now.
paras.zh: 雪熊沉重的爪子甩起泥浆，朝深渊猛冲，把安娜带得离克里斯托夫越来越远。“克里斯托夫！”安娜又喊，“克里斯托夫，回来！”可索伦森已经看见他了。

paras.en: The old man raised Kristoff’s pickax, its two hooked ends gleaming like wolf fangs as he moved toward Kristoff, who was now armed with only a fallen tree branch.
paras.zh: 老人举起克里斯托夫的镐，两只弯钩般的尖端如狼牙般闪着光，朝克里斯托夫逼近；而克里斯托夫此刻手里只有一根掉落的树枝。

paras.en: In any other circumstance, the victor of the fight would have been unquestionable.
paras.zh: 换作任何别的情形，这场打斗的胜者都毫无悬念。

paras.en: Kristoff was young, strong as an ox, and fresh from a summer of hauling blocks of ice up and down the mountain and from doing handiwork around the castle, while Sorenson was wizened with age, his face a crinkled map, his short limbs thin from years of sedentary study.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫年轻，壮得像头牛，刚过了一个夏天，不是上山搬冰块就是待在城堡里做杂活；而索伦森年老干瘦，脸像一张皱巴巴的地图，矮短的四肢因长年伏案而细弱。

paras.en: But the Nattmara had lent Sorenson its predatory grace and ruthless instinct.
paras.zh: 可纳特玛拉赋予了索伦森捕猎者的优雅与冷酷的本能。

paras.en: Sorenson moved like hot oil, fast and crackling, guaranteed to cause pain, sliding so fast it was hard to tell if Sorenson was now man or wolf or both.
paras.zh: 索伦森动起来像热油，又快又噼啪作响，注定带来痛楚，滑得飞快，叫人分不清他此刻是人、是狼，还是二者皆是。

paras.en: His swollen ankle did nothing to slow him.
paras.zh: 他那肿胀的脚踝丝毫没拖慢他。

paras.en: Sorenson chopped down with the stolen pickax, Kristoff only just whirling away from being sliced in two.
paras.zh: 索伦森抡下偷来的镐，克里斯托夫堪堪旋身，才没被劈成两半。

paras.en: He barely had time to look up before Sorenson was on him once more.
paras.zh: 他几乎来不及抬头，索伦森又扑了上来。

paras.en: The pickax swung down again and again with the deftness of a sewing needle.
paras.zh: 镐一下又一下落下，灵巧如缝衣针。

paras.en: Still, Anna could see Kristoff’s shaggy yellow hair dipping and dodging, tucking and rolling, just as the trolls had trained him to do.
paras.zh: 不过安娜看得见，克里斯托夫那蓬乱的黄发忽低忽闪、忽缩忽滚，正像地精训练他的那样。

paras.en: Anna wanted to leap off the sleigh and run to his side more than anything. “Do we go back?” Elsa called, the older sister asking the little sister what to do.
paras.zh: 安娜恨不得跳下雪橇奔到他身边。“我们要掉头吗？”艾莎喊，姐姐在问妹妹该怎么办。

paras.en: And of all times, Anna thought.
paras.zh: 安娜心想，偏挑这种时候。

paras.en: Elsa’s cloak snapped in the wind, and though she looked shaken, she still gripped the sparkling reins with the same steadiness as when she’d held her coronation scepter.
paras.zh: 艾莎的斗篷在风中啪啪作响，尽管她看似动摇，握着闪亮缰绳的手却仍如当年执掌加冕权杖时那般稳。

paras.en: They were almost upon the chasm. “You need to tell me, now!” Yes.
paras.zh: 他们已逼近深渊。“你得现在告诉我！”对。

paras.en: With the whole of her heart, Anna wanted to grab the reins from Elsa’s hands and tug the bear back toward Kristoff and the Nattmara-possessed Sorenson.
paras.zh: 安娜全心全意地想从艾莎手里夺过缰绳，把熊拉回克里斯托夫和那个被纳特玛拉附身的索伦森身边。

paras.en: But she couldn’t.
paras.zh: 可她不能。

paras.en: She wouldn’t.
paras.zh: 她不会。

paras.en: The shadows were already long.
paras.zh: 影子已经拉得老长。

paras.en: Night would soon be here—and then there would be dawn.
paras.zh: 夜很快将至——而之后便是黎明。

paras.en: The third dawn, the last dawn if Anna couldn’t get Revolute first.
paras.zh: 第三个黎明，若安娜不能先拿到回旋之刃，便是最后的黎明。

paras.en: Kristoff had given her a gift—a chance to undo what she had done.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫给了她一份礼物——一个弥补自己所犯之错的机会。

paras.en: And she couldn’t let it go to waste. “Keep going,” Anna croaked, even as her heart cracked.
paras.zh: 她不能让它白白浪费。“继续走，”安娜沙哑地说，尽管心已碎裂。

paras.en: Hot tears flew down her cheeks, mingling with the ash from the sky as Elsa tightened the reins and Bjorn jumped.
paras.zh: 热泪顺着她的脸颊滑落，与天空落下的灰烬交融，艾莎收紧缰绳，比约恩纵身一跃。

paras.en: Anna’s heart dropped into her stomach as they soared over the chasm.
paras.zh: 当他们飞越深渊时，安娜的心提到了嗓子眼。

paras.en: For a long moment, they seemed to dangle in the air, suspended by nothing thicker than spider’s silk over the gaping mouth of the earth.
paras.zh: 有漫长的一瞬，他们仿佛悬在半空，被细若蛛丝之物吊着，悬于大地张开的巨口之上。

paras.en: If they didn’t make it across, the sharp rocks hundreds of feet below were ready to rip and chew them apart.
paras.zh: 若他们越不过去，下方数百尺的尖石正等着把他们撕碎嚼烂。

paras.en: Anna tried to cling to the sleigh’s sides, but Elsa’s creation was flawless.
paras.zh: 安娜想抓住雪橇边，可艾莎的造物完美无瑕。

paras.en: There was no rough patch of ice she could grab hold of.
paras.zh: 没有一处粗糙的冰面能让她抓得住。

paras.en: No uneven knot she could clutch.
paras.zh: 没有一个不平的结能让她攥住。

paras.en: And so Anna clung to the only thing she could: her sister.
paras.zh: 于是安娜只能抓住唯一能抓的东西：她的妹妹。

paras.en: Seconds seemed to pass, and still the other side felt as far away as forever.
paras.zh: 数秒仿佛流过，可对岸仍远得像永远。

paras.en: And then, with a bone-rattling thump, the bear’s paws touched back down on the ground, and the sleigh and the sisters slammed down behind him—hard.
paras.zh: 接着，伴着一声震骨的闷响，熊的爪子落回地面，雪橇和姐妹俩重重砸在他身后。

paras.en: They had made it. “Anna, I can’t breathe!” Elsa squeaked out.
paras.zh: 他们过去了。“安娜，我喘不过气了！”艾莎尖声说。

paras.en: Anna let go of her sister, whirling around to see what had happened to Kristoff.
paras.zh: 安娜松开妹妹，猛地回头想看看克里斯托夫怎样了。

paras.en: She could just make out two figures beyond the chasm, but she could no longer tell which blur was the pickax and which was the branch.
paras.zh: 她只能勉强辨认出深渊对岸两个身影，却再也分不清哪团模糊是镐、哪团是树枝。

paras.en: They grew smaller and smaller as the bear lengthened his strides and the ground flew by, but she kept her eyes on the battling figures.
paras.zh: 随着雪熊步伐拉长、大地飞逝，那两个身影越来越小，可她仍盯着那两个搏斗的身影。

paras.en: Anna knew this dance could only last so long.
paras.zh: 安娜知道这场缠斗撑不了多久。

paras.en: In just a few hours, the sun would drop behind the horizon, and then the Nattmara would stop hiding in Sorenson’s body and resume its full power as the fearsome wolf.
paras.zh: 再过几小时，太阳就会落到地平线下，那时纳特玛拉将不再藏身索伦森体内，重新以那可怕的狼之全貌现身。

paras.en: Or would it possess Kristoff before then?
paras.zh: 还是说，在那之前它会先附身克里斯托夫？

paras.en: Would Kristoff be smothered by a nightmare reality?
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫会被噩梦般的现实所窒息吗？

paras.en: He’d live in his own horror-scape, where there were no trolls or reindeer, or quiet mountain solaces, or Anna.
paras.zh: 他会活在自己恐怖的境地里，那里没有地精，没有驯鹿，没有山间静谧的慰藉，也没有安娜。

paras.en: A nightmare world that might last forever, unless she and Elsa could stop it first. “Can we go any faster?” Anna’s throat was so tight that her question was barely more than a whisper.
paras.zh: 一个或许永恒的噩梦世界，除非她和艾莎能先阻止它。“我们能再快些吗？”安娜的喉咙紧得发不出声，这话几乎只是气音。

paras.en: In fact, she wasn’t actually sure she’d said anything at all.
paras.zh: 事实上，她都不确定自己究竟有没有出声。

paras.en: She felt about as substantial as a shadow and just as useful.
paras.zh: 她觉得自己轻飘飘的，像影子一样没什么分量，也同样无用。

paras.en: She wasn’t sure Elsa had heard her until she felt her sister’s hand squeezing hers. “We’ll go as fast as the wind,” Elsa promised, both hands back on the reins.
paras.zh: 直到感觉到妹妹的手攥紧自己的，她才确信艾莎听见了。“我们会快得像风，”艾莎许诺，双手重新握紧缰绳。

paras.en: They slid through the rocky terrain of the mountains, hurtling at a breakneck pace until Bjorn’s wild run ended at a cliffside.
paras.zh: 他们滑过山间嶙峋的地形，以玩命的速度疾驰，直到比约恩狂奔至一处崖边才停。

paras.en: A river rushed nearby, gaining speed and sound as it hurried to the mountain’s edge.
paras.zh: 一条河在附近奔腾，越近山缘越是湍急喧腾。

paras.en: They had reached the waterfalls—and the entrance to the Earth Giant’s Passage, to Aren’s tumulus. “We’re here.” Elsa stumbled out of the sleigh. “Hurry!” Looking down, Anna could make out the distinct shape of Arendelle Castle.
paras.zh: 他们到了瀑布——也到了大地巨人通道、阿伦陵冢的入口。“我们到了。”艾莎踉跄着下橇。“快！”安娜低头，能辨认出阿伦黛尔城堡清晰的轮廓。

paras.en: The ice bubble Elsa had so carefully and beautifully made had fractured, leaving sharp shards of ice around it, a terrain as dangerous as broken glass.
paras.zh: 艾莎精心又美丽地造出的冰泡已经碎裂，四周留下尖利的冰碴，地形如碎玻璃般危险。

paras.en: Next to it, Anna could see the village, the color of its homes still cheery despite the terror that Anna knew it now housed.
paras.zh: 在它旁边，安娜能看见村庄，尽管她知道村里如今满是恐惧，房屋的色调却仍是欢快的。

paras.en: But at least, she saw with relief, the ice dome Elsa had made for the village still held.
paras.zh: 但至少，她宽慰地看到，艾莎为村庄造的冰穹仍撑着。

paras.en: She looked toward the port.
paras.zh: 她望向港口。

paras.en: The royal ship, too, was gone, and Anna hoped that Sven, Olaf, and the villagers were far away by now, and safe.
paras.zh: 皇家船只也不见了，安娜希望斯文、雪宝和村民们此刻已远去，且平安无事。

paras.en: She couldn’t handle it if one single soul more was hurt because of her.
paras.zh: 若是再有一个灵魂因她而受伤，她承受不住。

paras.en: Because Kristoff…No.
paras.zh: 因为克里斯托夫……不。

paras.en: She couldn’t think about Kristoff.
paras.zh: 她不能去想克里斯托夫。

paras.en: Not now.
paras.zh: 现在不行。

paras.en: Slipping out of the sleigh, she helped Elsa free the snow bear from his harness.
paras.zh: 她溜下雪橇，帮艾莎解开雪熊的挽具。

paras.en: Without it, Bjorn looked ten times fiercer and ten times wilder, and Anna was aware that with just a single paw, he could crush her as easily as she could crush a crocus.
paras.zh: 卸下挽具，比约恩显得凶了十倍、野了十倍，安娜清楚，他一只爪子就能把她捏碎，就像她捏碎一朵藏红花般容易。

paras.en: But then, the bear shook himself, his fur rippling like seaweed, and pushed his cold nose into Anna’s hand.
paras.zh: 可接着，熊抖了抖身子，毛如海草般起伏，把冰凉的鼻子拱进安娜手里。

paras.en: He snuffled, and Anna flung her arms around his snowy ruff. “Thank you,” she said, squeezing Bjorn and allowing herself a moment of wonder.
paras.zh: 他喷了喷鼻息，安娜张开双臂搂住他雪白的颈毛。“谢谢你，”她说，紧抱比约恩，让自己沉醉片刻的惊奇。

paras.en: She was hugging a bear.
paras.zh: 她正抱着一头熊。

paras.en: She was hugging a bear!
paras.zh: 她正抱着一头熊！

paras.en: Elsa nodded. “Yes, thank you, Bjorn.” Bjorn waited for Anna’s one last squeeze, and looked at Elsa.
paras.zh: 艾莎点点头。“对，谢谢你，比约恩。”比约恩等安娜最后抱了一下，又望向艾莎。

paras.en: He seemed to nod his head in her direction.
paras.zh: 他仿佛朝她点了点头。

paras.en: But then he pulled away—and ran in the direction of the Nattmara, and Anna understood.
paras.zh: 可接着他抽身离去——朝纳特玛拉的方向跑去，安娜明白了。

paras.en: He’d helped them as best he could, and now he would try to lure the Nattmara away from them while they searched for Revolute. “Come on,” Anna said, excitement rising in her chest as she headed toward the waterfall. “If we’re right, we’re about to fix everything!” Elsa wrapped her scarf tighter around her shoulders. “But if we’re wrong, then…” Anna was glad Elsa didn’t finish her thought, because she couldn’t bear to hear it.
paras.zh: 他已竭尽全力帮了他们，如今要在他们寻找回旋之刃时，设法把纳特玛拉引开。“走吧，”安娜说着，胸口涌起兴奋，朝瀑布走去，“如果我们没错，就要把一切扭转过来了！”艾莎把围巾在肩头裹得更紧。“可如果我们错了，那……”安娜很高兴艾莎没把话说完，因为她不忍听下去。

paras.en: THEY WERE WRONG.
paras.zh: 他们错了。

paras.en: Anna was wrong.
paras.zh: 安娜错了。

paras.en: In the light of a torch that Elsa had found and ignited, Anna looked again at the dragon boat’s empty hull, a lump filling her throat.
paras.zh: 借着艾莎找到并点燃的火把，安娜再次望向龙船空荡荡的船体，喉咙里堵上一团东西。

paras.en: Once, there might have been mounds of gold, pottery, lush cloaks, and jars of rare spices to help send Aren the warrior on his valiant voyage.
paras.zh: 从前，这里或许堆着成堆黄金、陶器、华丽的斗篷，和一罐罐珍稀香料，为送战士阿伦踏上英勇航程而备。

paras.en: Once, this might have been a splendid place of sleek polished wood, a fitting resting place for Aren and his mighty sword.
paras.zh: 从前，这里或许是一处光洁木板筑成的华美之地，配得上做阿伦与他神剑的长眠之所。

paras.en: But now the rotten boards were barely strong enough to hold a dusty footprint, let alone a thing of myth.
paras.zh: 可如今，朽烂的木板几乎撑不住一个落满灰尘的脚印，更别提一件神话之物。

paras.en: Elsa stood in the hull with Anna, turning over a small clump of dirt with the toe of her boot.
paras.zh: 艾莎和安娜站在船体里，用靴尖拨弄着一小撮泥土。

paras.en: A cloud of dust trailed into the air, and Anna sneezed. “We’re too late,” Elsa said as she stepped over the remains of what might have once been an oar, “by a thousand years, give or take.
paras.zh: 一团尘土腾起，安娜打了个喷嚏。“我们来得太迟了，”艾莎迈过一截或许曾是桨的残骸说道，“迟了约莫一千年，上下浮动。”

paras.en: Maybe Revolute was here once—maybe this had even been Aren’s final resting place, but…” She trailed off, her eyes lingering on the holes in the porous old wood. “I think this boat has been empty for a long, long time.” No.
paras.zh: “也许回旋之刃曾在这里——也许这儿甚至就是阿伦最后的安息地，可是……”她住了口，目光停在多孔老木上的窟窿里，“我想这船空荡荡的，已经很久很久了。”不。

paras.en: They had come too far, risked too much. “Revolute is around here,” Anna said, kicking another clot of dirt with her boot only to reveal…more dirt.
paras.zh: 他们走得太远，冒了太大险。“回旋之刃就在附近，”安娜说，用靴子又踢开一团泥，却只露出……更多的泥。

paras.en: She knew many boats had secret watertight compartments in the floor, but she had searched and found none. “It just has to be here!” But even as she said it, Anna knew that wasn’t necessarily true.
paras.zh: 她知道许多船的底舱设有秘密防水隔间，可她搜遍了也没找到一个。“它一定就在这儿！”可即便这么说，安娜也明白未必如此。

paras.en: In fact, nothing just had to be anywhere.
paras.zh: 事实上，没有什么“就一定”该在哪儿。

paras.en: If just had to be counted for anything, then a great storm would have never met Mother and Father’s ship.
paras.zh: 若“一定”能算数，那场大风暴就绝不会撞上父母的船。

paras.en: It would mean that King Runeard’s life wouldn’t have been taken by dangerous northerners, and that young Elsa and Anna would have known their grandfather.
paras.zh: 那意味着鲁内尔德王不会丧命于危险的北方人之手，年幼的艾莎和安娜也能认识她们的祖父。

paras.en: It would mean that Sven would have never gotten the Blight, and that Anna would have never called a Nattmara to the kingdom by manifesting it from her fears and nightmares.
paras.zh: 那意味着斯文永远不会染上枯萎病，安娜也永远不会从自己的恐惧与噩梦里唤出纳特玛拉、将它招来王国。

paras.en: Suddenly, it was just all too much .
paras.zh: 突然间，一切实在太沉重了。

paras.en: Anna felt the weight of all the earth and sea and castle fall onto her shoulders and crush her, snuffing out her last bit of hope.
paras.zh: 安娜感到大地、海洋与城堡的全部重量压上肩头，将她碾碎，掐灭了她最后一丝希望。

paras.en: She had not found the Revolute Blade, and she never would.
paras.zh: 她没找到回旋之刃，也永远不会找到了。

paras.en: She would never be able to defeat the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 她永远无法击败纳特玛拉。

paras.en: She would never see Kristoff or Olaf or Sven ever again.
paras.zh: 她再也见不到克里斯托夫、雪宝或斯文了。

paras.en: She stepped out of the boat and lowered her head into her hands, and tears began to fall. “Oh, Anna,” Elsa said, following her.
paras.zh: 她走出船，把头埋进手里，眼泪掉了下来。“噢，安娜，”艾莎跟着她说。

paras.en: Anna felt pressure on her shoulder as her sister crouched down next to her in the flickering torchlight. “Please, please, please don’t cry,” Elsa said. “It’s not your fault.
paras.zh: 火把摇曳的光里，妹妹蹲到她身旁，安娜感到肩头一沉。“求求你，求求你，别哭，”艾莎说，“这不是你的错。”

paras.en: If I had been doing a better job, I would have recognized the signs, and we could have stopped the Nattmara before you called it into the kingdom.” Anna knew Elsa was trying to be comforting, but her words only made Anna feel a hundred times worse.
paras.zh: “若我做得更好些，早该看出征兆，就能在你把它招进王国前拦住纳特玛拉。”安娜知道艾莎是想安慰她，可这些话只让她难过百倍。

paras.en: They were just more proof that Elsa didn’t need Anna anymore—that, in fact, Elsa might even be better off without Anna.
paras.zh: 这不过是更多证据，证明艾莎已不再需要安娜——事实上，没了安娜，艾莎说不定反而更好。

paras.en: Anna dragged her face away from her hands, and leaning against the rough-hewn wall, she put her head back and looked up at the dragon figurehead, its mouth opened in an eternal snarl, unable to ever really stop thieves from stealing its treasures.
paras.zh: 安娜把脸从手里抬起来，靠着粗糙凿出的墙，仰起头望向龙首像——它大张着嘴，永远在咆哮，却从没能真正挡住小偷窃取它的珍宝。

paras.en: Anna closed her eyes, shutting out its accusing wooden eyes.
paras.zh: 安娜闭上眼，把那双仿佛在控诉的木眼睛关在门外。

paras.en: Maybe it would be best for Elsa and all of Arendelle if the wooden dragon could just come to life and swallow Anna and her great disappointments whole, like how the wolf had swallowed her in her nightmare.
paras.zh: 也许，若这木龙能活过来，把安娜和她巨大的失望一口吞下，就像梦里那头狼吞了她一样，对艾莎和整个阿伦黛尔反倒最好。

paras.en: She wasn’t exactly sure what that would do, but…Anna’s runaway thoughts lurched to a halt as an idea grabbed on to them.
paras.zh: 她也不确定那样会怎样，可……安娜脱缰的思绪猛地一停，一个念头抓住了它。

paras.en: She looked back up at the wooden dragon, its mouth gaping open. “Elsa!” Anna rose to her feet.
paras.zh: 她重新抬头望向木龙，它大口张着。“艾莎！”安娜站起身。

paras.en: Elsa lifted the torch as she stood, too. “What is it, Anna?” “I think I know where the sword is!” And without waiting for her sister to interrupt, Anna continued to barrel ahead. “We were just looking in the hull of the boat, because that’s where one would end up if you were eaten—in the belly of a dragon, or in the boat.
paras.zh: 艾莎也站起，举起火把。“怎么了，安娜？”“我想我知道剑在哪儿了！”安娜不等妹妹插话，径自冲口而出，“我们方才只在船体里找，因为若被吞下，就该落在龙肚子里或船里。”

paras.en: But the myth doesn’t say that the dragon ate Aren, it says—” “He was swallowed,” Elsa said, eyes growing wide. “Revolute could be hidden in the dragon’s mouth!” Anna nodded. “Exactly!” The dragon’s snarling mouth reared several feet above their heads.
paras.zh: “可神话说的不是龙吞了阿伦，而是——”“他被吞了，”艾莎睁大眼睛，“回旋之刃可能就藏在龙嘴里！”安娜点头，“正是！”龙那咆哮的嘴，高高地昂在他们头顶数尺之上。

paras.en: Usually, Elsa would be able to wave her hands and make a staircase out of ice.
paras.zh: 换作平时，艾莎挥挥手就能造出冰做的阶梯。

paras.en: But they weren’t under the Huldrefólk’s protection anymore.
paras.zh: 可他们已不在胡尔德民的庇护之下。

paras.en: If Elsa used as much as a lick of her magic, the Nattmara would be upon them in seconds.
paras.zh: 只要艾莎用上一丝魔法，纳特玛拉几秒内就会扑到他们身上。

paras.en: Crawling out onto the dragon’s neck also wasn’t an option.
paras.zh: 爬到龙脖子上去，也行不通。

paras.en: The boat was a thousand, maybe even thousands of years old, and the peeling, splintering wood had as many holes as a sponge.
paras.zh: 这船已有一千年，或许数千年之久，剥落、碎裂的木头像海绵一样满是窟窿。

paras.en: The whole thing looked like it might collapse if Anna so much as breathed on it.
paras.zh: 整艘船看着仿佛安娜只要轻轻一吹，就会塌掉。

paras.en: Elsa planted the torch in the ground and crouched down. “All right, get on.” “What?” Anna looked at her sister, confused. “We need to get someone up there.
paras.zh: 艾莎把火把插进地里，蹲下身。“好了，上来。”“什么？”安娜困惑地看着妹妹，“我们得有人上去。”

paras.en: I think you can reach it if you get on my back.” “A piggyback ride?
paras.zh: “我想你骑到我背上，就能够到。”“背人？”

paras.en: Really?” said Anna, a grin breaking across her face. “You haven’t offered me one of those since before the gates closed.” “Well,” Elsa said with a smile, “I guess I owe you at least one more.” Kicking off her boots, Anna scrambled up onto her sister’s back.
paras.zh: “真的？”安娜说，脸上绽开笑，“自从城门关闭前，你就再没背过我。”“嗯，”艾莎笑着说，“我想我至少还欠你一次。”安娜踢掉靴子，爬上妹妹的背。

paras.en: Then, balancing herself against the wooden hull, she placed her feet on Elsa’s shoulders and pulled herself into a standing position so she was eye to eye with the dragon.
paras.zh: 接着，她靠着木船体稳住身子，双脚踩上艾莎的肩，把自己拉成站立的姿势，好与龙平视。

paras.en: Even though centuries had scrubbed it clear of most of its details, up close, Anna could still see the hatch marks that hinted at scales, and the expression of the dragon.
paras.zh: 尽管数百年已磨去它大部分细节，近看时，安娜仍能看见暗示鳞片的刻痕，以及龙的神情。

paras.en: From below, the expression had seemed to be of a snarling angry beast, but now, Anna thought maybe it wasn’t angry, just protective.
paras.zh: 从下往上看，那神情像一头咆哮的怒兽，可此刻安娜觉得，它或许不是愤怒，只是守护。

paras.en: Nerves bubbled throughout Anna’s body.
paras.zh: 安娜浑身紧张得冒泡。

paras.en: This was it.
paras.zh: 就是这一刻了。

paras.en: Their one shot.
paras.zh: 他们唯一的机会。

paras.en: Their last chance.
paras.zh: 他们最后的机会。

paras.en: The Revolute Blade, the very thing that had carved out Arenfjord and made a home for a wandering people.
paras.zh: 回旋之刃，正是它劈出了阿伦峡湾，为漂泊的族群安了家。

paras.en: A sword forged from a curved sunbeam with an unusual power, a gift from the sun herself.
paras.zh: 一柄由弯弯阳光锻成、蕴含奇异力量的剑，太阳女神赐下的礼物。

paras.en: They would defeat the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 他们要击败纳特玛拉。

paras.en: They would cure the crops and animals and people of the Blight, and free everyone she loved from their own terrifying nightmares. “Do you have it?” Elsa asked from underfoot.
paras.zh: 他们要治愈庄稼、动物和人身上的枯萎病，把每一个她所爱的人，从他们各自可怕的噩梦里解放出来。“你拿到了吗？”脚下的艾莎问。

paras.en: Whoops.
paras.zh: 哎呀。

paras.en: Anna’s mind was running away again. “No, not yet!” Anna said, reining in her galloping thoughts. “Well, hurry up!
paras.zh: 安娜的思绪又跑远了。“还没，没呢！”安娜说，勒住狂奔的念头，“那快点儿啊！”

paras.en: You don’t exactly weigh the same as you did when you were five.” No, Anna wasn’t five years old.
paras.zh: “你现在可不像五岁时那么轻了。”是啊，安娜不是五岁了。

paras.en: She was capable of making serious mistakes, but she was also just as capable of fixing them.
paras.zh: 她会犯严重的错，可也同样有能力去弥补。

paras.en: And so, she reached her hand into the dragon’s mouth.
paras.zh: 于是，她把手伸进龙嘴。

paras.en: At first, there was nothing there.
paras.zh: 起先，里面空无一物。

paras.en: Frowning, Anna leaned farther into the dragon’s gaping maw, her elbow disappearing, followed by the rest of her arm, until the wood hit her armpit.
paras.zh: 安娜皱起眉，更往龙张大的嘴里探，手肘没了进去，接着整条胳膊，直到木头抵住她的腋窝。

paras.en: Worry crept through her.
paras.zh: 担忧悄悄爬上心头。

paras.en: If the dragon’s head was hollow, would she need to crawl all the way in?
paras.zh: 若龙头是空的，她是不是得整个人爬进去？

paras.en: She wasn’t sure if she would fit.
paras.zh: 她不确定自己塞不塞得进去。

paras.en: If only Olaf were there, he’d be able to send his hand down inside.
paras.zh: 要是雪宝在就好了，他能把手伸进里面去。

paras.en: Or even Sven would have been helpful, with his sensitive nose.
paras.zh: 就算斯文在也有用，凭他灵敏的鼻子。

paras.en: But they weren’t, so Anna would have to do it herself. “Anna,” Elsa said, “your foot is starting to dig into my shoulder.” “Sorry,” Anna said. “Just one more second.” Taking a breath to balance herself, she rose to her tiptoes, stretching, reaching until her fingers brushed something cold and metal-smooth.
paras.zh: 可他们不在，所以安娜只能自己来。“安娜，”艾莎说，“你的脚快嵌进我肩膀里了。”“抱歉，”安娜说，“再一秒就好。”她吸口气稳住身子，踮起脚尖，伸长手臂，直到指尖触到一样冰冷、光滑如金属的东西。

paras.en: Something that fit comfortably in her palm as she wrapped her hand around it.
paras.zh: 她握拢手，那东西恰好服帖地躺进掌心。

paras.en: Something that sent a note of anticipation through her.
paras.zh: 那东西让她心里涌起一阵期待。

paras.en: Anna pulled.
paras.zh: 安娜往外一拉。

paras.en: At first, there was resistance, and then a whisper of metal, a noise that almost sounded like a dragon’s sigh as its secret came loose.
paras.zh: 起先有阻力，接着是金属的一声轻响，那声响几乎像龙的一声叹息，随着秘密被松开。

paras.en: And then Anna’s hand was back in the rippling orange light of the torch.
paras.zh: 接着，安娜的手回到了火把摇曳的橘光里。

paras.en: Could it truly be?
paras.zh: 这真的会是它吗？

paras.en: The hilt was wrought from gold, and in the center of the pommel, like a miniature sun, sat a yellow diamond.
paras.zh: 剑柄由黄金铸成，柄头正中，嵌着一颗黄钻，像一轮小小的太阳。

paras.en: The gold of the handguard had been worked to look like little rays of the sun, leading down to the blade.
paras.zh: 护手的金子被打成一道道小阳光的模样，一路引向剑刃。

paras.en: And the blade…it was made of a blue-black metal—the same color as the meteorite in Sorenson’s observation tower.
paras.zh: 而剑刃……它由一种蓝黑色的金属打造——和索伦森观测塔里那块陨石一个颜色。

paras.en: It curved, the slight S -shape mirroring the inlet of Arenfjord, where myth said Aren had made the legendary cut.
paras.zh: 它弯着，那微微的S形，正映着阿伦峡湾的入海口——神话里说，阿伦就是在那里划下了那传奇的一刀。

paras.en: But Anna hardly dared to believe that what she held was what she needed it to be.
paras.zh: 可安娜几乎不敢相信，手里的就是她需要的东西。

paras.en: Not until she’d carefully slipped down from Elsa’s back.
paras.zh: 直到她小心地从艾莎背上滑下来。

paras.en: Not until Elsa tore a scrap of cloth from her split dress and began to polish the top of the blade, right below where it met the hilt.
paras.zh: 直到艾莎从自己撕裂的裙子上扯下一片布，开始擦拭剑刃顶端、紧挨剑柄下方的部位。

paras.en: Not until she could read the letters that had been etched into the sword itself did Anna believe: R-E-V-O-L-U-T-E They’d found it.
paras.zh: 直到她能读出刻在剑身上的字母，安娜才相信：R-E-V-O-L-U-T-E 他们找到了。

paras.en: The carver of the first fjord.
paras.zh: 第一个峡湾的开辟者。

paras.en: The myth and the solution.
paras.zh: 神话，也是解法。

paras.en: The Revolute Blade.
paras.zh: 回旋之刃。

paras.en: “WE DID IT!” Anna shouted, forgetting the need to be quiet and embracing Elsa. “Careful!” Elsa twisted the sword away. “You don’t want to accidentally stick us.” Though Elsa’s warning wasn’t really all that funny, for some reason, it planted a seed of humor in Anna.
paras.zh: “我们做到了！”安娜忘了要安静，一把抱住艾莎喊道。“小心！”艾莎把剑挪开，“你可别不小心扎着我们。”虽说艾莎的警告其实并不怎么好笑，不知为何，却给安娜心里种下了一颗幽默的种子。

paras.en: A giggle slipped out, and then, a bloom of laughter.
paras.zh: 一声轻笑溜了出来，接着，笑声如花绽放。

paras.en: And instead of trying to trap it down, Anna let it rush through her, throwing back her head and laughing long and loud.
paras.zh: 安娜没有试图压住它，而是任它奔涌而过，仰起头，放声大笑。

paras.en: Elsa looked confused, which only made Anna laugh harder.
paras.zh: 艾莎一脸困惑，这反倒让安娜笑得更厉害。

paras.en: Then, ever so slowly, Elsa’s lips began to turn upward, and she giggled; then she, too, laughed, loud and free.
paras.zh: 接着，艾莎的嘴角极缓地向上弯起，咯咯笑起来；随后她也放声大笑，自由而畅快。

paras.en: Their laughter echoed around the Earth Giant’s Passage, bounding and rebounding, patching the tiny rip in Anna’s heart caused by constant worrying.
paras.zh: 她们的笑声在大地巨人之道里回荡，来回碰撞，修补着安娜因不停担忧而在心上扯出的小裂口。

paras.en: Because Anna had done it.
paras.zh: 因为安娜做到了。

paras.en: She’d proven to Elsa that she still needed her little sister who made mistakes.
paras.zh: 她向艾莎证明了，妹妹仍需要这个会犯错的自己。

paras.en: She’d proven that she could actually accomplish exactly what she had planned to do.
paras.zh: 她证明了自己确实能完成当初打算做的事。

paras.en: Suddenly, Elsa stopped laughing, and it was only Anna’s laughter that bounced around the walls, sounding alone and by itself. “Hey,” Anna said, somewhat breathless. “What’s wrong?” Elsa held her finger to her lips, and Anna listened.
paras.zh: 忽然，艾莎止了笑，墙间只剩安娜的笑声在弹跳，听起来形单影只。“嘿，”安娜有点喘地说，“怎么了？”艾莎把手指抵在唇上，安娜便侧耳去听。

paras.en: Without the protective barrier of laughter, she could now hear another sound coming from beyond the waterfall and the passage.
paras.zh: 没了笑声这道屏障，她此刻能听见瀑布与通道之外传来的另一种声响。

paras.en: A long, low angry howl.
paras.zh: 一声悠长、低沉、愤怒的嚎叫。

paras.en: The Nattmara was nearing. “We need to get out here,” Anna said, slipping her boots back on. “Or else it’ll trap us in the tunnel.” “Agreed.” Elsa nodded.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉逼近了。“我们得离开这儿，”安娜套回靴子说，“不然它会把我们困在隧道里。”“同意。”艾莎点头。

paras.en: Already, she was tightening the band around her braid. “But Anna, I think—” “That we need a plan,” Anna said, finishing her sister’s sentence, as they so often did. “Yes, you’re right!
paras.zh: 她已经收紧辫子上的发带。“不过安娜，我觉得——”“我们得有个计划，”安娜接过妹妹的话头——她们常这样，“对，你说得对！”

paras.en: The plan—the-plan-the-plan-the-plan…You use your magic to distract the Nattmara—only for a second or two!—and then I’ll surprise it with Revolute.
paras.zh: 计划——计划计划计划计划……你用魔法引开纳特玛拉——只一两秒！——然后我用回旋之刃打它个措手不及。

paras.en: That’s a brilliant idea, Elsa!” “But I—” Elsa began, and that was all Anna could really make out, because she’d already tugged Revolute from Elsa’s hand and begun to sprint down the passageway for the exit and the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 这主意太妙了，艾莎！”“可是我——”艾莎刚开口，安娜只听清这几个字，因为她已经把回旋之刃从艾莎手里抽走，朝出口和纳特玛拉冲去。

paras.en: Fear thrummed through her veins, and yet, she had Revolute.
paras.zh: 恐惧在她血管里轰鸣，可她手里有回旋之刃。

paras.en: She had hope.
paras.zh: 她有希望。

paras.en: Anna squeezed the hilt tight, the yellow diamond pressing into her hand.
paras.zh: 安娜紧攥剑柄，那颗黄钻硌进掌心。

paras.en: It almost hurt, but still she kept running, trusting in the power of the myth and trusting her sister to follow behind her with an icy blast or whirl of hard wind.
paras.zh: 几乎有些疼，可她仍不停跑，信赖着神话的力量，也信赖妹妹会带着一阵冰爆或凛冽的旋风跟在身后。

paras.en: The still-frozen waterfall sparkled up ahead, and Anna squeezed herself out onto the narrow ledge and exited the passageway only to stop in her tracks.
paras.zh: 前方，那依旧冻住的瀑布闪着光，安娜挤上狭窄的岩台，走出通道，却猛地刹住脚步。

paras.en: Because the land sprawled before her was not the home she knew.
paras.zh: 因为眼前铺展开的大地，已不是她熟悉的家园。

paras.en: Her home had a cheery village with painted houses, a fjord full of rich blue waters, and a vibrant display of autumnal colors that would have made her paint set jealous.
paras.zh: 她的家园有色彩明快的村庄、刷过漆的房屋、注满浓蓝海水的峡湾，还有一派鲜活的秋色，连她的颜料盒都要自愧不如。

paras.en: But the land before her was bleached white, as though this reality were being erased to make way for the nightmare that was settling in for eternity.
paras.zh: 可眼前的大地一片惨白，仿佛这现实正被抹去，好为那要永久驻留的噩梦让路。

paras.en: Like storm clouds rolling in, the Nattmara prowled the village edge.
paras.zh: 如翻滚而来的风暴云，纳特玛拉在村庄边缘徘徊。

paras.en: When Anna had first spotted the wolf in the Great Hall, it’d been bigger than any wolf she’d ever seen, but not abnormally so.
paras.zh: 安娜初在大厅里望见那头狼时，它比她见过的任何狼都大，却也没大到离谱。

paras.en: Then it’d become twice the size of a normal wolf, then the size of a bull, then the size of a knoll.
paras.zh: 后来它长到寻常狼的两倍大，再后来像头牛，再后来像座小丘。

paras.en: But now, its eyes were level with the second-floor windows of the village townhouses.
paras.zh: 可如今，它的眼睛已与村庄楼房的二层窗齐平。

paras.en: It was exactly as Sorenson had foretold.
paras.zh: 正如索伦森预言的那样。

paras.en: Each hour that the Nattmara had not been banished, it’d grown in strength and size as it gorged on the fear that had swept over the land.
paras.zh: 每过一个时辰未被驱逐，纳特玛拉就随着吞噬席卷大地的恐惧，长得更强更大。

paras.en: Each stride of its paw seemed to cover a mile, and wherever it passed, the trees twisted away from it, as if they, too, could sleep and dream and wanted none of the Nattmara’s offerings.
paras.zh: 它每迈一爪，仿佛就跨出一英里；所经之处，树木纷纷扭身避开，仿佛它们也会睡、会做梦，且对纳特玛拉的馈赠毫无兴趣。

paras.en: As if poplars and aspens and spruces, too, wanted to run away.
paras.zh: 仿佛白杨、白桦与云杉，也都想逃开。

paras.en: Anna had thought that the Nattmara would come directly for her, its accidental summoner, but instead of tearing up the path that would take it to the waterfall and to Revolute, the Nattmara turned…and loped back toward the village.
paras.zh: 安娜本以为纳特玛拉会直奔她这个误召者而来，可它没去撕扯通往瀑布与回旋之刃的小路，而是转身……小跑着折返村庄。

paras.en: In the time that it took Anna to blink, the giant wolf had arrived at the edge of the protective ice dome over the village.
paras.zh: 安娜眨眼的工夫，巨狼已抵达村庄上方那座防护冰穹的边缘。

paras.en: Rearing back on its hind legs, it struck the dome with a heavy paw.
paras.zh: 它后腿直立，用沉重的爪子砸向冰穹。

paras.en: THUMP!
paras.zh: 砰！

paras.en: The ice stayed whole and smooth.
paras.zh: 冰面完好光滑。

paras.en: The dome was working—but for how long?
paras.zh: 冰穹还在起效——可还能撑多久？

paras.en: The Nattmara swung again.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉又挥了一爪。

paras.en: THUMP!
paras.zh: 砰！

paras.en: Anna frowned.
paras.zh: 安娜皱起眉。

paras.en: Had that thump been followed by a cracking sound?
paras.zh: 那声闷响之后，是不是跟着一声脆裂？

paras.en: The Nattmara only needed to make a fissure as thin as a hair for it to be able to trickle though Elsa’s barrier in its black sand form. “Anna!” Elsa said, flying out from behind the waterfall to join Anna on the ledge overlooking the village. “I need you to—” “We have to go help them!” Anna yelled, desperation making her voice shrill.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉只需划出一道细如发丝的裂缝，就能以黑沙之身渗过艾莎的屏障。“安娜！”艾莎从瀑布后飞出，落到安娜所在的、俯瞰村庄的岩台上，“我要你——”“我们得去救他们！”安娜喊道，绝望让她的声音尖利。

paras.en: The villagers—they had no idea of the danger they were in.
paras.zh: 村民们——他们根本不知道自己身处险境。

paras.en: They were all asleep!
paras.zh: 他们都睡着了！

paras.en: She took a step forward to run—but her foot stayed put, rooted to the ground as though it had been locked in place.
paras.zh: 她向前迈步欲跑——脚却钉在原地，像被锁住般扎进了地里。

paras.en: What?
paras.zh: 什么？

paras.en: Anna looked down to see a lacy frost pattern rising up from the ground, snapping together like links on a chain and wrapping around her foot.
paras.zh: 安娜低头，看见一幅蕾丝般的霜花图案正从地面升起，像锁链的一环环咔哒扣合，缠住了她的脚。

paras.en: While Anna gaped, something tugged on Revolute, and without thinking, Anna let go.
paras.zh: 安娜目瞪口呆间，有东西扯住了回旋之刃，她想也没想便松了手。

paras.en: Too late, she realized what she’d done.
paras.zh: 等她反应过来，已太迟。

paras.en: Looking back up, she saw Elsa standing in front of her, holding Aren’s sword with both hands.
paras.zh: 她抬头，看见艾莎站在面前，双手握着阿伦的剑。

paras.en: She no longer looked like Anna’s older sister, or even a queen.
paras.zh: 她看上去不再像安娜的姐姐，甚至不像一位女王。

paras.en: She looked like a soldier. “Elsa.” Her words sounded small even to her own ears. “What are you doing?” “I’m sorry,” Elsa said, and Anna could hear the truth in her sister’s words, but still, Elsa made no move to stop the advancing frost.
paras.zh: 她像个士兵。“艾莎。”这话连安娜自己听着都显得渺小，“你在做什么？”“对不起，”艾莎说，安娜听得出妹妹话里的真心，可艾莎仍没有停下逼近的霜。

paras.en: It circled around Anna, shuttling back and forth on itself like yarn on a loom to form a white tapestry, rising higher and higher. “I failed to protect the kingdom,” Elsa said, “but I’m not going to fail you, too!” Failed?
paras.zh: 霜绕着安娜，像织机上的纱线般来回穿梭，织成一幅白色的挂毯，越升越高。“我没能护住王国，”艾莎说，“但我绝不会再辜负你！”辜负？

paras.en: Anna didn’t know what Elsa was talking about.
paras.zh: 安娜不懂艾莎在说什么。

paras.en: Elsa never failed at anything . “Elsa,” Anna said as the frost crystals scattered up over her head, dancing into a domed roof. “I don’t need to be protected!” It felt like Anna’s whole being had contracted and collapsed in on itself, like a black hole or a dark abyss.
paras.zh: 艾莎从不会在任何事上失败。“艾莎，”霜晶在安娜头顶散开、舞成圆顶时，安娜说，“我不需要被保护！”安娜只觉得整个自己都向内收缩、塌陷，像黑洞，又像黑暗的深渊。

paras.en: She felt as though she’d become no bigger than the head of a pin.
paras.zh: 她觉得自己缩得比针尖还小。

paras.en: The last frost link clicked into place, finishing not a tapestry, but a bubble-like tent.
paras.zh: 最后一环霜链扣合，完成的不是挂毯，而是一个泡状的帐子。

paras.en: Anna found she could move her feet again, the frost chain that had held her to the ground slithering away to weave itself into the structure.
paras.zh: 安娜发现脚又能动了，那把她钉在地上的霜链蜿蜒退去，织进帐子结构里。

paras.en: It didn’t matter, though, if Anna could move her feet or not, because Elsa hadn’t bothered to make a door. “I love you,” Elsa said, sounding for a moment like she was younger than Anna or even Echo.
paras.zh: 可动不动脚都无所谓，因为艾莎压根没做门。“我爱你，”艾莎说，有那么一瞬，声音听起来比安娜甚至比回声还小。

paras.en: And then she was running, sprinting down the dirt path to the village below, Revolute a curved gleam in her hand. “Come back!” Anna yelled. “Elsa!” She pounded her fists against the frost, but the walls were so strong, so solid, and so cold, that each pummel felt like a bite.
paras.zh: 接着她跑了起来，沿土路冲向山下村庄，回旋之刃在她手中弯成一道微光。“回来！”安娜喊，“艾莎！”她用拳头砸向霜壁，可墙那么坚固、结实又冰冷，每一下都像被咬了一口。

paras.en: The frost links held fast, keeping Anna locked away.
paras.zh: 霜链牢牢锁住，把安娜囚在其中。

paras.en: Anna was useless as she watched Elsa reach the end of the path and run toward the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 安娜眼睁睁看着艾莎跑到路尽头、冲向纳特玛拉，却无能为力。

paras.en: Useless as the Nattmara caught Elsa’s scent and turned toward her sister, its fearsome claws extended.
paras.zh: 无能为力地看着纳特玛拉嗅到艾莎的气味，转向她妹妹，伸出可怕的利爪。

paras.en: And useless as Elsa strode forward, ready to become the great ruler that Arendelle needed…just as Aren had done.
paras.zh: 也无能为力地看着艾莎大步向前，准备成为阿伦黛尔需要的伟大统治者……正如阿伦当年那样。

paras.en: But it would be okay.
paras.zh: 不过，会没事的。

paras.en: It would be okay it would be okay it would be okay.
paras.zh: 会没事的会没事的会没事的。

paras.en: Elsa wielded the myth that could defeat the myth.
paras.zh: 艾莎握着能击败神话的神话。

paras.en: She held in her hand the crescent blade that had carved their home on Arenfjord.
paras.zh: 她手里握着那弯刃，曾劈出他们在阿伦峡湾的家。

paras.en: If Revolute could do that, surely it could defeat a Nattmara summoned by a scared little sister.
paras.zh: 连回旋之刃都能做到那事，必定也能打败一个被吓坏的小妹妹召唤出的纳特玛拉。

paras.en: Still, Anna held her breath as she watched, too far away to help, yet at the same time too close, because she could see it all.
paras.zh: 可安娜仍屏住呼吸看着，远得帮不上忙，却又近得能看见一切。

paras.en: A howl of wind clashed with the howl of the wolf as Elsa intercepted the Nattmara at the base of the Bridge of Arches.
paras.zh: 当艾莎在拱桥（Bridge of Arches）脚下截住纳特玛拉时，风的嚎叫与狼的嚎叫撞在一处。

paras.en: Elsa looked like a doll in front of the monstrous wolf, which had grown so tall that its ears were at the height of the castle’s waving flags.
paras.zh: 在那怪物般的狼面前，艾莎像个玩偶；狼已长得极高，耳朵齐着城堡上飘动的旗帜。

paras.en: Even from a distance, Anna could see the slip of saliva that hung from the Nattmara’s fangs as it began to circle her sister, its great yellow eyes locked on Elsa.
paras.zh: 即便隔着距离，安娜也能看见纳特玛拉獠牙上挂着的一缕涎水，它开始绕着妹妹打转，巨大的黄眼锁定艾莎。

paras.en: This was a thousand times worse than any of Anna’s nightmares.
paras.zh: 这比安娜任何一场噩梦都要糟糕千倍。

paras.en: In all her nightmares but the last, she’d been in some sort of control.
paras.zh: 在除了最后那场的每一场噩梦里，她都还算能掌控些什么。

paras.en: She’d always been able to puzzle her way out somehow, or distract the creature long enough that she could wake up.
paras.zh: 她总能用某种办法解开谜团脱身，或把那怪物引开足够久，好让自己醒来。

paras.en: But even if Anna could break free from the frost bubble, she would not be able to wake up.
paras.zh: 可就算安娜能挣脱霜泡，她也无法醒来。

paras.en: The wolf and her sister circled each other.
paras.zh: 狼和妹妹彼此绕着圈。

paras.en: Elsa’s cloak and scarf flapped in great gusts of wind as she twirled one hand and clutched Revolute with the other.
paras.zh: 艾莎的披风与围巾在阵阵狂风里翻飞，她一只手旋舞，另一只手握着回旋之刃。

paras.en: But something was wrong.
paras.zh: 可有些不对劲。

paras.en: Even though Elsa was controlling the gusts of ice, no matter which direction she commanded the snow and ice to go, the wolf would force her to turn her back into the magic so that her hair and billows of icy magicked air constantly whipped into her eyes.
paras.zh: 尽管艾莎操控着阵阵冰风，可无论她让雪与冰往哪个方向去，狼都会逼她背对魔法，于是她的头发和一团团冰魔法气息不停抽打进她眼里。

paras.en: There was no way for Elsa to clearly see.
paras.zh: 艾莎根本没法看清。

paras.en: And then, the Nattmara attacked.
paras.zh: 接着，纳特玛拉攻了上来。

paras.en: Elsa and Revolute whirled away, the Nattmara’s teeth snapping on thin air.
paras.zh: 艾莎连同回旋之刃旋身避开，纳特玛拉的牙咬了个空。

paras.en: It retreated for a moment, then struck again.
paras.zh: 它退开片刻，又再次扑击。

paras.en: This time, a terrible screech filled the air as a fang scraped across the blade.
paras.zh: 这一次，尖牙擦过剑刃，一声可怕的厉啸划破空气。

paras.en: Or maybe the screech was Anna’s own scream.
paras.zh: 或许那厉啸是安娜自己的尖叫。

paras.en: Because Elsa now lay between the Nattmara’s giant paws, sprawled like a spider, her limbs askew, and her hand empty.
paras.zh: 因为此刻艾莎躺在纳特玛拉巨大的爪间，像只蜘蛛般四肢摊开，手里空空。

paras.en: Revolute flew through the air, a blue-black streak, and landed several feet behind Elsa.
paras.zh: 回旋之刃飞过空中，一道蓝黑的弧光，落在艾莎身后几尺外。

paras.en: Anna saw Elsa’s hand sweep out, trying to feel for the sword without taking her eyes away from the Nattmara. “REVOLUTE!” Anna shouted, though she knew Elsa wouldn’t be able to hear her. “TO YOUR LEFT!” The Nattmara licked its maw, its fangs poised above Elsa.
paras.zh: 安娜看见艾莎的手伸出去，想摸剑又不肯把目光从纳特玛拉身上移开。“回旋之刃！”安娜喊，尽管她知道艾莎听不见，“在你左边！”纳特玛拉舔着嘴，獠牙悬在艾莎上方。

paras.en: For a moment, Anna saw in startling detail the gleam of the Nattmara’s claws and rise in her sister’s chest as Elsa took a deep breath.
paras.zh: 有一瞬，安娜清晰地看见纳特玛拉利爪的反光，以及艾莎深吸一口气时胸膛的起伏。

paras.en: Then, the Nattmara lunged down.
paras.zh: 接着，纳特玛拉猛扑而下。

paras.en: But in the space that it took for Anna to blink, Elsa had lunged, too.
paras.zh: 可就在安娜眨眼的一瞬，艾莎也扑了出去。

paras.en: She grabbed for Revolute’s hilt.
paras.zh: 她伸手去抓回旋之刃的剑柄。

paras.en: In one fluid movement, she held it up in front of her—the ancient blade flashing in the light of the setting sun—and thrust it into the roof of the Nattmara’s mouth.
paras.zh: 一个流畅的动作，她把剑举到身前——古剑在落日余晖中闪光——刺进纳特玛拉口腔上颚。

paras.en: Anna waited for the Nattmara to fall and disintegrate into dust, defeated at last by a thing of myth, just as Sorenson had said that it could be.
paras.zh: 安娜等着纳特玛拉倒下、化为尘土，终被一件神话之物击败，正如索伦森所说它能的那样。

paras.en: Instead, the world slowed and stilled as the Nattmara bit down.
paras.zh: 然而，纳特玛拉一口咬下，世界随之变慢、凝滞。

paras.en: And Revolute—the great, mythic sword of Aren’s oldest hero, the sword that had carved the Arenfjord from the mountains, slain beasts, and conquered nightmares—shattered like glass.
paras.zh: 而回旋之刃——阿伦最古老英雄那柄伟大的神话之剑，那柄从群山劈出阿伦峡湾、斩杀野兽、征服噩梦的剑——如玻璃般碎裂。

paras.en: Bits of the meteorite blade sparkled as they sprayed uselessly to the ground, raining down on Elsa, who now lay completely defenseless in front of the Nattmara. “ELSA!” Anna roared, pounding at her prison of frost. “ELSA!
paras.zh: 陨石剑刃的碎片闪着光，徒劳地溅落地面，如雨般落在艾莎身上——她此刻全无防备，躺在纳特玛拉面前。“艾莎！”安娜咆哮，捶打着霜做的牢笼，“艾莎！”

paras.en: Use your magic!” Maybe it was a trick of the wind, but Elsa appeared to turn her head in the waterfall’s direction.
paras.zh: 用你的魔法！”或许是风的戏法，艾莎似乎把头转向了瀑布的方向。

paras.en: For one second, it almost seemed that Elsa looked at her.
paras.zh: 有一瞬，艾莎几乎像是在看她。

paras.en: Glancing down, Anna saw that the frost bubble had started to dissolve into thin air—not good!
paras.zh: 安娜低头，看见霜泡已开始消散于无形——不妙！

paras.en: If Elsa’s magic was dissolving, that must mean that Elsa was weakening, too.
paras.zh: 若艾莎的魔法在消散，那必是艾莎也在变弱。

paras.en: But Anna was now free!
paras.zh: 可安娜现在自由了！

paras.en: She began to run down the path even though she knew that she would not make it in time, but still, she had to try.
paras.zh: 她沿路跑下去，尽管知道自己赶不及，可她必须试试。

paras.en: Elsa would have—no, Elsa had —done the same for her.
paras.zh: 艾莎会——不，艾莎确实——为她做过同样的事。

paras.en: The Nattmara threw back its leviathan head and howled its victory.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉仰起巨兽般的头，嚎出它的胜利。

paras.en: And as it rose once more above her sister, its white fur shifted into a glittering black as the Nattmara morphed into a cloud of sand that stood out starkly against the faded landscape.
paras.zh: 当它再次在妹妹上方升起，白毛化作闪烁的漆黑——纳特玛拉变成一团沙云，在褪色的景致中分外扎眼。

paras.en: The bits and pieces swirled together, forming a spinning column.
paras.zh: 沙粒旋转汇聚，结成一根旋柱。

paras.en: And then the sand slammed down into Elsa’s chest…and disappeared. “Elsa!” Anna sobbed, stumbling into range. “Elsa!” Her sister sprawled on the ground, her eyes closed and her blond hair coming loose from its braid and spilling onto fallen leaves.
paras.zh: 接着那沙猛地砸进艾莎胸口……消失了。“艾莎！”安娜抽泣着踉跄靠近，“艾莎！”妹妹瘫在地上，双眼紧闭，金发从辫子里松脱，散落在落叶上。

paras.en: Scattered around her like a broken halo were the blue-black shards of what had once been the great sword Revolute.
paras.zh: 她四周散落着蓝黑的碎片，像破碎的光环——那曾是伟大的回旋之刃。

paras.en: And though Anna knew what would happen next, she still wasn’t prepared for when Elsa’s eyelids fluttered open to reveal glowing yellow eyes.
paras.zh: 尽管安娜知道接下来会发生什么，当艾莎的眼皮颤动睁开、露出发光的黄眼时，她仍毫无准备。

paras.en: Anna’s stomach heaved at the sight of the wolf’s eyes in her sister’s familiar face.
paras.zh: 看见熟悉的脸上嵌着狼的眼睛，安娜的胃一阵翻涌。

paras.en: Her stride slowed. “Elsa?” she called out hesitantly.
paras.zh: 她的脚步慢了下来。“艾莎？”她迟疑地喊。

paras.en: Elsa opened her mouth…and screamed.
paras.zh: 艾莎张开嘴……尖叫起来。

paras.en: And then she raised her hands, blasting Arendelle with her powers, her usually white snow and white ice now replaced by black snow and black ice.
paras.zh: 接着她举起双手，以魔力轰击阿伦黛尔，往常的白雪白冰，如今换成了黑雪黑冰。

paras.en: No, not black snow or black ice.
paras.zh: 不，不是黑雪，也不是黑冰。

paras.en: Black sand .
paras.zh: 是黑沙。

paras.en: As Elsa continued to scream, the sound swept through Anna, hollowing her out like the wolf’s howl had, until there was nothing left except for Elsa’s scream within her, reverberating against her ribcage, echoing again and again in her complete emptiness.
paras.zh: 艾莎的尖叫不停，那声音扫过安娜，把她掏空，正如狼的嚎叫曾做过的那样，直到她心里什么都不剩，只有艾莎的尖叫在胸腔里回荡，在她彻底的空虚中一遍遍回响。

paras.en: In her utter aloneness.
paras.zh: 在她彻底的孤独里。

paras.en: Revolute had shattered, and Elsa’s eyes were yellow. “Elsa,” Anna sobbed, not knowing what do. “Elsa…Elsa…Elsa!” But the figure who had been her sister did not even turn to face her.
paras.zh: 回旋之刃碎了，艾莎的眼睛是黄色的。“艾莎，”安娜抽泣着，不知所措，“艾莎……艾莎……艾莎！”可那曾为她妹妹的身影，连头都没转过来面对她。

paras.en: With great heaving gasps, Anna gathered the shards of the sword into her cloak pocket—a futile hope.
paras.zh: 安娜大口喘着，把剑的碎片拢进披风口袋——一线徒劳的希望。

paras.en: Because Revolute, the famed sword of myth, had not been enough to defeat a beast of myth.
paras.zh: 因为声名远扬的神话之剑回旋之刃，竟不足以击败一头神话之兽。

paras.en: The myth was no longer a myth.
paras.zh: 神话，已不再是神话。

paras.en: It had not saved her sister.
paras.zh: 它没能救下妹妹。

paras.en: And the sound of Elsa’s scream—or was it the wolf’s howl?—pulled her into the black dots gathering at the edge of her vision.
paras.zh: 而艾莎尖叫的声音——还是狼的嚎叫？——把她拽进了视野边缘聚拢的黑点里。

paras.en: Anna didn’t know which was which, but the nightmares stormed in and dragged her down. “Elsa,” she managed to croak out one last time.
paras.zh: 安娜分不清哪个是哪个，可噩梦汹涌袭来，将她拖垮。“艾莎，”她最后勉强嘶哑地喊了一声。

paras.en: No longer knowing what was real and what was a nightmare, or if they were now truly one and the same, Anna saw Elsa at last turn to her.
paras.zh: 再也分不清何为真实、何为噩梦，也不知它们如今是否真已合而为一，安娜看见艾莎终于转向她。

paras.en: Elsa raised her hands, and black sand erupted from her palms toward Anna.
paras.zh: 艾莎举起双手，黑沙从掌心喷涌，朝安娜扑来。

paras.en: Darkness swirled around Anna, and then, at last, there was nothing at all.
paras.zh: 黑暗在安娜四周盘旋，终于，一切都归于虚无。

paras.en: ANNA WOKE TO HER MOTHER singing a lullaby.
paras.zh: 安娜在母亲唱的摇篮曲中醒来。

paras.en: She knew it was just a dream, and so she kept her eyes shut, letting herself drift in the familiar and comforting melody.
paras.zh: 她知道那只是梦，于是闭着眼，任自己在熟悉而安心的旋律里漂浮。

paras.en: Though she couldn’t make out the lyrics, she had a sense of the story behind it.
paras.zh: 尽管听不清歌词，她却能感到旋律背后的故事。

paras.en: A story from long ago, in that time before time, when the world was sprightly green and the rivers bubbled with enchantment.
paras.zh: 那是很久以前、时间尚未开始的故事，那时世界一派鲜绿，河流冒着魔法的泡泡。

paras.en: That time when the sun would step down from the sky and walk along the earth, just to feel the grass tickle her feet and to discuss philosophy with the wind.
paras.zh: 那时太阳会走下天空，在大地上漫步，只为感受青草挠着她的脚，与风谈论哲学。

paras.en: It was an olden song, a song of strength and meekness, revenge and love.
paras.zh: 那是首古老的歌，一首讲述刚强与柔顺、复仇与爱的歌。

paras.en: The sound was sweet, but it was not real.
paras.zh: 声音甜美，却并不真实。

paras.en: Anna knew that.
paras.zh: 安娜知道。

paras.en: Mother was gone.
paras.zh: 母亲已经不在了。

paras.en: Father, too.
paras.zh: 父亲也是。

paras.en: And now Elsa… Yellow eyes and a haunted kingdom.
paras.zh: 如今连艾莎……黄眼，和一个被缠住的国家。

paras.en: Tears dripped from beneath her eyelashes, but Anna still didn’t open them.
paras.zh: 泪珠从睫毛下滴落，可安娜仍没有睁开眼。

paras.en: She wanted to stay suspended in the dark, cocooned away until someone had cleaned up her mess.
paras.zh: 她想悬在黑暗里，像被茧裹住，直到有人把她惹的乱子收拾干净。

paras.en: Something cold patted her cheek. “Anna, quit joking around.
paras.zh: 有冰凉的东西拍了拍她的脸。“安娜，别开玩笑了。”

paras.en: Wake up.” This voice was familiar, too.
paras.zh: “醒醒。”这声音她也熟悉。

paras.en: Anna opened her eyes to find herself nose to carrot with Olaf. “You’re leaking,” he informed her, referring to the tears she was shedding. “Olaf, what are you doing here?” Anna swiped at her eyes and looked away from Olaf’s nose to see branchless trees swaying above her.
paras.zh: 安娜睁开眼，发现自己正和雪宝鼻子对胡萝卜。“你在漏水，”他告诉她，指的是她正掉的眼泪。“雪宝，你在这儿做什么？”安娜抹了抹眼睛，把视线从雪宝的鼻子移开，看见头顶摇晃的、没有枝桠的‘树’。

paras.en: No, not trees—masts.
paras.zh: 不，不是树——是桅杆。

paras.en: Three tall ones, each strung with the ropes and nets of a working ship and boasting wide billowing sails.
paras.zh: 三根高高的桅，每根都挂着劳作船只的缆绳与网，张扬着鼓满的风帆。

paras.en: Above the slap of the waves, Anna could hear singing—but it wasn’t her mother, it was Tuva the blacksmith, who stared out at the dark night over the royal ship’s rail, her lilting voice filling the salt-sprayed air. “Anna’s awake!” Olaf shouted. “How did you get here?” Anna asked Olaf. “How did I get here?” She looked around and beside her, and saw Sven wrapped in a large blanket, still fast asleep, though his legs twitched and sweat sheened his almost now completely white coat.
paras.zh: 浪花拍击之上，安娜听见歌声——但不是母亲，而是铁匠图娃，她凭倚皇家船的船舷，望着黑夜，轻快的嗓音填满咸湿的空气。“安娜醒了！”雪宝喊。“你怎么到这儿的？”安娜问雪宝。“我怎么到这儿的？”她环顾左右，看见斯文裹在大毯子里，仍熟睡着，只是腿在抽动，几乎全白的毛上闪着汗光。

paras.en: Only a little patch of brown fur remained on his flaring nose. “Hoo-hoo!” Oaken said, stomping into view, his cheeks a bit redder than usual from the cold sea air. “We watched everything from the harbor!
paras.zh: 他翘起的鼻子上，只余一小撮棕毛。“嗬——嗬！”奥肯迈步现身，海上的冷气让他的脸颊比平时更红，“我们从港口把一切看在眼里！”

paras.en: When Scary Elsa vanished inside the castle, we crept ashore and carried you back.
paras.zh: “当可怕的艾莎消失在城堡里，我们悄悄上岸，把你运了回来。”

paras.en: We thought both you and Sven would rest better next to one another.” “I thought you had already sailed away!” Anna said, perplexed.
paras.zh: “我们想，你跟斯文挨着，会都睡得好些。”“我还以为你们已经开船走了！”安娜困惑地说。

paras.en: She also wondered why she hadn’t fallen under the nightmare sleep.
paras.zh: 她也纳闷，自己怎么没陷入那噩梦般的沉睡。

paras.en: She studied her hands, not sure what she expected to see. “We were going to,” Tuva called from the ship’s stern, her hands on the helm.
paras.zh: 她端详着自己的手，不知自己期望看到什么。“我们本要走的，”图娃在船尾喊，双手把着舵。

paras.en: In the yellow lantern light, the blacksmith looked ragged and her curly hair had been tugged into a cloud of frizz by the wind.
paras.zh: 黄灯笼的光里，铁匠看着有些狼狈，卷发被风扯成一团蓬乱。

paras.en: Her brown eyes, however, remained warm as she looked at Anna. “But then we had a change of heart.
paras.zh: 可她望向安娜时，棕色的眼睛依旧温热。“但后来我们改了主意。”

paras.en: And a good thing, too—or else we wouldn’t have been able to pick up SoYun.” “Since I live on the outskirts of the village,” SoYun said softly as she appeared from behind the post, a coil of thick rope in her arms, “the wolf ran straight by—and at that very moment, the rest of my herd fell asleep.
paras.zh: 幸好改了——不然我们也接不上苏允。”“我住在村庄郊外，”苏允从柱子后现身，怀里抱着一卷粗绳，轻声说，“那头狼径直跑了过去——就在那一刻，我其余的鹿群都睡着了。”

paras.en: I realized I had to go seek a solution myself.
paras.zh: “我意识到，得自己去寻个解法。”

paras.en: So I rowed out onto the sea, hoping to find someone awake on the water, and that’s how they”—she gestured to Tuva and Oaken—“found me.” “I’m so glad,” Anna said, and she was pleased to note that while SoYun’s long black braid wasn’t yet in its usual tidiness, she looked less terrified than when she’d come upon Anna and Elsa in the woods.
paras.zh: “于是我划船出海，盼着能在水上遇见醒着的人，他们——”她朝图娃和奥肯示意，“就是这样找到我的。”“我真高兴，”安娜说，并欣慰地注意到，苏允的长黑辫虽还没恢复平日的齐整，神情却比在林中撞见安娜与艾莎时镇定多了。

paras.en: In fact, SoYun looked determined. “But,” Anna said, looking back at Tuva, “what kind of change convinced you to return?” “You,” Tuva said simply.
paras.zh: 事实上，苏允一脸坚定。“可是，”安娜回头看向图娃，“是什么让你改变主意回来的？”“你，”图娃简单地说。

paras.en: Anna blinked. “What do you mean?” Tuva turned the wheel, and the sails above rippled in the night breeze. “I mean,” she said, “that if a young woman like you could stick around, even though all was falling apart, and you don’t have powers of snow and ice, and I doubt you can lift a blacksmith’s hammer above your head for even a minute—then why couldn’t we?
paras.zh: 安娜眨了眨眼。“什么意思？”图娃转着舵轮，上方的帆在夜风里轻颤。“我的意思是，”她说，“像你这样一个年轻姑娘，明知一切都在崩塌，还留下来，又没有冰雪的魔力，连铁匠的锤子只怕都举不过一分钟——那我们为什么不能留下？”

paras.en: After all, Arendelle is just as much our home as it is yours. “We’d only sailed out a little ways when we realized that we needed to return.
paras.zh: 毕竟，阿伦黛尔既是你的家，也是我们的家。“我们才驶出一点点，就意识到该回来。”

paras.en: And so, we agreed to turn around in case you were still out there.
paras.zh: “于是我们商定掉头，万一你还在外面。”

paras.en: And you were.
paras.zh: “而你确实在。”

paras.en: So we scooped you up just in time and carried you to the ship, and now we’ve set sail again.” “We’re keeping an eye on the castle,” SoYun added. “Elsa…she’s…” “Still in there,” Tuva finished darkly. “Thank you.
paras.zh: “于是我们及时把你捞起，送上船，如今又起航了。”“我们一直盯着城堡，”苏允补充，“艾莎……她……”“还在里面，”图娃阴沉地接完，“谢谢你。”

paras.en: H-how long have I been asleep?” Anna said.
paras.zh: “我、我睡了多久？”安娜说。

paras.en: Her thoughts reeled with the vision of Elsa falling victim to the Nattmara. “Only a few hours!” Olaf called from the prow. “Which is actually a short amount of time when you take in the eons of our galaxy.” Anna’s heart sped up.
paras.zh: 她的思绪随着艾莎沦为纳特玛拉牺牲品的画面翻腾。“才几个小时！”雪宝在船头喊，“若放在我们银河的亿万年里，其实很短。”安娜的心加速了。

paras.en: It was still the same night. “And when’s sunrise?” “In just an hour,” Oaken said.
paras.zh: 还是同一个夜晚。“日出是什么时候？”“再过一小时，”奥肯说。

paras.en: An hour.
paras.zh: 一小时。

paras.en: Arendelle had a single hour before this terror became permanent.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔只剩最后一小时，这场恐怖就会成为永久。

paras.en: Uneasy, Anna rose to her feet and headed to the railing.
paras.zh: 安娜不安地起身，走向船舷。

paras.en: She stared down at the black waters of the Arenfjord.
paras.zh: 她俯视阿伦峡湾的黑水。

paras.en: They slapped relentlessly against the ship’s hull, giving rhythm to the terrible thoughts that swarmed through Anna’s mind: Elsa, failure, Elsa.
paras.zh: 黑水无情地拍着船体，为安娜脑中成群涌过的可怕念头打着节拍：艾莎，失败，艾莎。

paras.en: A tear coursed down her cheek.
paras.zh: 一滴泪顺着脸颊滑下。

paras.en: Anna’s greatest fear wasn’t a wolf.
paras.zh: 安娜最大的恐惧不是狼。

paras.en: It never had been.
paras.zh: 从来不是。

paras.en: It had been losing her sister.
paras.zh: 是失去妹妹。

paras.en: Olaf took Anna’s hand in his. “You’re melting,” he said. “I wish I could share my permafrost with you.” Anna smiled as she wiped her face with the back of her hand. “I’m okay, Olaf.” She paused. “Actually,” she admitted, “I’m not okay.
paras.zh: 雪宝握住安娜的手。“你在融化，”他说，“真希望我能把我的永冻分给你。”安娜用手背抹了抹脸，微微一笑。“我没事，雪宝。”她顿了顿，“其实，”她承认，“我不好。”

paras.en: All along I wanted to go on the grand tour with Elsa on this very ship, but now…It was supposed to be a journey that Elsa and I did together.” And though Anna didn’t say it, she thought: Just like taking care of the castle is something we’re supposed to do together, too.
paras.zh: “一直以来，我都想和艾莎乘这艘船去大巡游，可如今……这本该是艾莎和我一起走的旅程。”尽管安娜没说出口，她心里却想：正如照料城堡，也本该是我们一起做的事。

paras.en: But even after the trip to the Huldrefólk, Elsa still hadn’t trusted her to get rid of the Nattmara, and now, their one and only chance of defeating the nightmare—Revolute—lay in tiny jagged pieces in her cloak pocket.
paras.zh: 可哪怕去过胡尔德民那里之后，艾莎仍不放心把驱逐纳特玛拉交给她，而如今，他们击败噩梦的唯一机会——回旋之刃——已碎成她披风口袋里细小的锯齿状碎片。

paras.en: Sven suddenly bellowed, and Anna looked just in time to see him thrash wildly, his legs moving as though he were running for his life, even as he slumbered.
paras.zh: 斯文忽然大叫，安娜及时看去，只见他剧烈抽搐，腿动得像在逃命，即便还在沉睡。

paras.en: Anna ran over and sank down beside him, her skirt billowing around her.
paras.zh: 安娜跑过去，在他身旁蹲下，裙摆围在身边。

paras.en: Careful to avoid his hooves, she reached out and tenderly began to pat his nose.
paras.zh: 她小心避开蹄子，伸手轻轻拍起他的鼻子。

paras.en: Slowly, Sven stopped kicking, but his ears continued to twitch. “I ruined it all,” she said, continuing to pet Sven gently on the head. “I thought I finally had the answer.
paras.zh: 斯文渐渐不踢了，可耳朵还在抽动。“我把一切都毁了，”她一边继续轻抚斯文的头，一边说，“我以为自己终于找到了答案。”

paras.en: But”—she drew a long, shuddering breath—“I thought wrong.
paras.zh: “可是——”她长长吸了口发颤的气，“我想错了。”

paras.en: And Elsa—she was right not to trust me to come along on her grand tour, or to defeat the Nattmara, or to do anything at all.” “Ah-hem,” came a familiar throat-clearing.
paras.zh: “还有艾莎——她不信任我，不让我跟她去大巡游，不让去击败纳特玛拉，什么都不让我做，她是对的。”“咳——哼，”一阵熟悉的清嗓声传来。

paras.en: She turned to see Wael climbing up out of the ship’s hull.
paras.zh: 她转身，看见威尔从船舱里爬上来。

paras.en: Quickly, she looked away and kept her head bent toward the water, using her hair as a curtain.
paras.zh: 她迅速移开目光，埋下头朝向水面，拿头发当帘子。

paras.en: She didn’t think she could stomach the nosy journalist’s judgment.
paras.zh: 她觉得自己受不了这位多管闲事记者的评断。

paras.en: She barely felt like she could handle anything at all. “Ah- hem .” The throat clearing became more insistent. “I couldn’t help overhearing, but, well…have you been belowdecks yet?
paras.zh: 她几乎觉得什么都无法承受。“咳——哼。”清嗓声更执着了，“我不小心听到了，不过……你到过下层甲板了吗？”

paras.en: To Elsa’s study?” Anna shook her head.
paras.zh: “去艾莎的书房？”安娜摇摇头。

paras.en: She’d been to the royal ship to help unload rations, but she had made it a point to avoid Elsa’s cabin, unwilling to see it piled high with the luggage that would accompany Elsa far from home. “Then I suggest you check it out.” “I don’t know,” Anna said, thinking of the wild hair that now fanned around Elsa’s face and the yellow eyes of the Nattmara set into her sockets.
paras.zh: 她来过皇家船帮忙卸补给，却刻意避开艾莎的舱房，不愿看见里面堆满将陪艾莎远行的行李。“那我建议你去看看。”“我不确定，”安娜说，脑中浮现艾莎此刻乱发披面、眼眶里嵌着纳特玛拉黄眼的模样。

paras.en: That image would haunt her forever, she was certain of it. “It—it would hurt too much to see right now,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 那画面会缠她一辈子，她确信。“现、现在看到，会太痛了，”安娜说。

paras.en: Olaf slid his hand into hers. “Sometimes, you walk into a cave thinking you’ll find wolves inside, but they turn out to be puppies.” With a heavy sigh, Anna shuffled after Olaf, following him and Wael downstairs to Elsa’s study.
paras.zh: 雪宝把小手放进她掌心。“有时候，你走进山洞，以为里面是狼，结果却是小狗。”安娜沉沉叹了口气，拖着步跟在雪宝身后，随他和威尔下楼去了艾莎的书房。

paras.en: As she walked, she kept sneaking glances at Wael.
paras.zh: 走着时，她不断偷眼打量威尔。

paras.en: She was surprised that he’d been willing to come back and help her.
paras.zh: 她惊讶于他竟愿意回来帮她。

paras.en: Wael caught one of her glances and exhaled. “I know what you’re thinking,” he said as he stepped onto a groaning stair. “You do?” Anna said, her cheeks warming slightly.
paras.zh: 威尔捕捉到她的一瞥，吁了口气。“我知道你在想什么，”他踏上吱呀作响的楼梯说，“是吗？”安娜说，脸颊微热。

paras.en: Wael nodded. “You think that because I ask you and your sister hard questions about the kingdom, that I must not like you or Arendelle very much.” He opened the door to Elsa’s floating quarters and paused a moment to look at Anna. “But the truth is, I ask hard questions because I love Arendelle so much, and because I believe in you and Elsa.
paras.zh: 威尔点点头。“你以为，正因为我老拿王国的事难为你和妹妹，就必定不那么喜欢你们或阿伦黛尔。”他打开艾莎水上居室的门，停了片刻看向安娜，“可真相是，我问那些尖锐的问题，正因为太爱阿伦黛尔，也因为我相信你和艾莎。”

paras.en: You know, asking questions is often the first step to accomplishing something.” And Anna was surprised to realize that yes, she exactly knew.
paras.zh: “要知道，提问往往就是做成一件事的第一步。”安娜惊讶地发现，对，她完全明白这话。

paras.en: She smiled at Wael and said, “Thank you so much for your questions, and for coming back to help us.” And she meant it with the whole of her being.
paras.zh: 她对威尔笑道：“真谢谢你那些提问，也谢谢你回来帮我们。”这话她是由衷说的。

paras.en: Wael returned the smile and stepped back so that she could enter.
paras.zh: 威尔回以微笑，退后一步让她进去。

paras.en: Anna gasped.
paras.zh: 安娜倒吸一口气。

paras.en: Everywhere, there were sunflowers.
paras.zh: 满眼都是向日葵。

paras.en: Painted sunflowers danced across wooden beams and were carved into the handles of the cupboards.
paras.zh: 画里的向日葵在木梁上起舞，还被刻进橱柜的把手。

paras.en: A plush sunflower rug, cheery yellow and spring green, lay at the base of the stairs.
paras.zh: 楼梯脚下，铺着一块毛茸茸的向日葵地毯，明快的黄与春绿。

paras.en: Sunflowers weren’t Elsa’s favorite flowers.
paras.zh: 向日葵不是艾莎最喜欢的花。

paras.en: They were Anna’s .
paras.zh: 是安娜的。

paras.en: Elsa must have asked that the entire study be decorated to remind her of her sister.
paras.zh: 艾莎一定是吩咐把整个书房都装饰成这样，好让她记起妹妹。

paras.en: To remind her of home.
paras.zh: 记起家。

paras.en: And in the center of the room hung a newly commissioned portrait of two little girls, one with white-blond hair and the other chestnut brown, skating across a frozen pond.
paras.zh: 房间正中，挂着一幅新订的画像：两个小女孩，一个金白发，一个栗棕发，正在冰封的池塘上滑冰。

paras.en: The entire room felt like a hug.
paras.zh: 整个房间像一个拥抱。

paras.en: Wael went to the desk and pulled out a page from the stacks that had already accumulated in anticipation of Elsa’s grand tour. “This is the one that I thought you might like to see,” Wael said, handing it to her before slipping out, leaving Anna alone with Olaf.
paras.zh: 威尔走到书桌前，从早已为艾莎大巡游积起的纸堆里抽出一页。“我想你或许想看这个，”威尔说，递给她后便溜出门，留下安娜和雪宝独处。

paras.en: Anna peered down at the paper, then did a double take.
paras.zh: 安娜低头看那张纸，随即愣了愣。

paras.en: It was a proclamation written in Elsa’s elegant handwriting: I, Elsa, Queen of Arendelle, do hereby proclaim my sister, Anna of Arendelle, Keeper of the Kingdom while I sail on the grand tour.
paras.zh: 那是一份用艾莎优雅笔迹写的公告：我，阿伦黛尔女王艾莎，特此宣布，在我出海大巡游期间，由我妹妹、阿伦黛尔的安娜，担任王国守护者。

paras.en: She is kind, thoughtful, and loves Arendelle with the whole of her heart.
paras.zh: 她善良、体贴，以全心爱着阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: There is none better than her to watch over the kingdom while I am away.
paras.zh: 我不在时，无人比她更适合看顾王国。

paras.en: At last, Anna had an answer.
paras.zh: 终于，安娜有了答案。

paras.en: The reason Elsa had not invited her on the grand tour—it wasn’t because Elsa thought Anna was incompetent.
paras.zh: 艾莎没邀她同去大巡游的原因——不是因为艾莎觉得安娜不行。

paras.en: It was because she knew Anna was helpful, and she needed Anna at home to keep an eye on things.
paras.zh: 而是因为她知道安娜有用，需要安娜留在家里照看一切。

paras.en: Of course Elsa didn’t want Anna leaving Arendelle.
paras.zh: 艾莎当然不想让安娜离开阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: Arendelle needed Anna just as much as Anna needed it. “Now that’s true love!” said Olaf, who had angled his head to read it. “It is,” said Anna with a sad smile.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔需要安娜，正如安娜需要它。“这才叫真爱！”雪宝歪着头读完，说道。“是啊，”安娜苦笑着说。

paras.en: All this time, Anna had thought that Elsa believed she was useless, but maybe that wasn’t the case at all.
paras.zh: 一直以来，安娜以为艾莎觉得她没用，可也许根本不是那样。

paras.en: Maybe the only person who hadn’t believed that Anna was helpful…was Anna herself .
paras.zh: 也许，唯一不认为安娜有用的人……是安娜自己。

paras.en: She remembered the ice bubble that Elsa had enclosed her in.
paras.zh: 她想起艾莎把她裹进的冰泡。

paras.en: She’d thought it had been Elsa doing one more protective big sister act, but what if it was meant to be more than that?
paras.zh: 她原以为，那又是艾莎做姐姐的保护之举，可如果它别有深意呢？

paras.en: What if she wasn’t trying to be protective of Anna, but she was instead arming Anna, forcing her to wait and watch, because she trusted her to figure out the solution if the worst should happen? “Olaf,” Anna said, “would you mind getting Tuva down here, please?
paras.zh: 如果她不是要保护安娜，而是要让安娜武装起来，逼她等候、观察，是因为她信任安娜——若最坏的事发生，安娜能想出解法呢？“雪宝，”安娜说，“请你把图娃叫到这儿来好吗？”

paras.en: We don’t have much time.” Half an hour later, though, Anna’s fragile hope had once again unraveled.
paras.zh: “我们时间不多了。”然而半小时后，安娜那脆弱的希望又散了。

paras.en: She’d laid out the collected pieces of Revolute across Elsa’s desk to see if Tuva could piece them together, but the blacksmith shook her head. “The pieces are too small, and the metal—I’ve never seen anything like it before.
paras.zh: 她把收集来的回旋之刃碎片摊在艾莎书桌上，看图娃能否拼回，可铁匠摇了头。“碎片太小，而且这金属——我从没见过这样的东西。”

paras.en: Maybe I could do it if Ada”—her breath caught on her wife’s name—“were around and I had access to our forge, but there’s no way it can be fixed in time, and definitely not on this ship without the proper tools.” “Why would you fix it?” Wael called from the doorway. “The sword didn’t work the first time—what makes you think it would work this time?” “Because,” Anna said, keeping her eye on the porthole.
paras.zh: “若阿达——”她念到妻子名字时顿了顿，“——在身边，又有我们的锻炉，或许我能行，可绝不可能及时修好，更不可能在这船上、没有合适的工具。”“你为什么还想修它？”威尔在门口喊，“剑第一次就没用——凭什么觉得这次会有用？”“因为，”安娜盯着舷窗说。

paras.en: Was the night sky beginning to brighten? “You can only defeat a myth with a thing of myth, and Revolute is definitely a thing of myth.
paras.zh: 夜空是不是开始泛亮了？“你只能以神话之物击败神话，而回旋之刃绝对是神话之物。”

paras.en: Besides”—she turned her head to look at the map of Arendelle pinned to the wall.
paras.zh: “而且——”她转头看向钉在墙上的阿伦黛尔地图。

paras.en: It reminded her of the map she had uncovered in the secret room, the one where her mother had written one of their father’s many sayings—“my father used to say the past has a way of returning.” “And what goes around comes around again, like a sneeze in the wind,” Olaf added.
paras.zh: 那让她想起在密室里揭开的那张地图，母亲曾在上面写下父亲诸多箴言之一——“我父亲常说，过去自会以某种方式归来。”“而且因果轮回，像风里的喷嚏，”雪宝补了一句。

paras.en: He sat at the desk, examining the pieces of the shattered sword. “Maybe you should look at Revolute and Aren’s past.” Anna sighed. “I would, but I don’t exactly have a copy of the Saga of Aren on me at the moment, and Elsa’s not here to declaim.” “Ah-hem,” Wael coughed. “Elsa is not the only one who studied the classics.” “Apologies, Wael,” Anna said. “Please perform, but quickly.” Unease filled her, but she tamped it down. “We’re running out of time.” “‘Revolving moon and spinning sun, forged a crescent blade…’” Wael began, and Anna half listened as she tried to skim the other documents that might be helpful. “Hey, Anna,” Olaf said, “don’t you think it’s funny how you can find love in the most curious places?” Anna tried not to sigh.
paras.zh: 他坐在桌边，端详着碎剑的残片。“也许你该看看回旋之刃和阿伦的过去。”安娜叹气。“我倒是想，可这会儿我手边没有《阿伦传奇》，艾莎也不在，没人能吟诵。”“咳哼，”威尔咳嗽，“研究古典的不只艾莎一个。”“抱歉，威尔，”安娜说，“请念吧，快一点。”不安涌上她心头，她压了下去，“我们没时间了。”“‘旋转的月亮与流转的太阳，锻成一弯新月之刃……’”威尔开口，安娜半听半试着扫视其他或许有用的文件。“嘿，安娜，”雪宝说，“你不觉得，在最有意思的地方遇见爱，很好玩吗？”安娜忍住没叹气。

paras.en: She loved when Olaf discussed philosophy— usually —but now, mere minutes before sunrise, was not the time. “Yeah, sure I do.
paras.zh: 她平时爱听雪宝聊哲理——通常——可现在，离日出只剩几分钟，不是时候。“是啊，当然。”

paras.en: Why are you asking?” “Because,” Olaf said, “it’s sitting here on the desk.” Anna looked over, trying to see what he was talking about.
paras.zh: “你为什么问？”“因为，”雪宝说，“它就坐在桌上呢。”安娜望过去，想看清他说的是什么。

paras.en: She had not realized that Olaf had been rearranging the broken pieces of Revolute, specifically the top part of the blade that had held the inscription of the sword’s name, which now spelled out: L-O-V-E R-E-T-U “‘The sea rushed in as hidden power flowed from the gleaming sword,’” Wael continued to proclaim—and Anna’s heart skipped a beat.
paras.zh: 她没注意到，雪宝一直在重排回旋之刃的碎片，尤其是剑刃顶端、刻着剑名的部分，此刻拼成了：L-O-V-E R-E-T-U“‘海水涌入，隐秘的力量自闪亮的剑中流出’，”威尔继续吟诵——安娜的心猛地一跳。

paras.en: A hidden power.
paras.zh: 一股隐秘的力量。

paras.en: Anna’s heart began beating again, but twice as fast, as thoughts tumbled through her mind and she took in the other letters.
paras.zh: 安娜的心又跳起来，却快了一倍，思绪在脑中翻滚，她看清了另外那些字母。

paras.en: A grin spread across her face. “Oaken!” she yelled up to the deck. “Turn this ship around again!
paras.zh: 她脸上绽开笑。“奥肯！”她朝甲板喊，“把船再掉头！”

paras.en: We have a kingdom to save.”
paras.zh: “我们还有个国家要救。”

paras.en: ANNA KNEW WHERE TO FIND HER SISTER.
paras.zh: 安娜知道去哪儿找妹妹。

paras.en: The nearer the night drew to sunrise, the more foreign Anna’s home had seemed to become.
paras.zh: 夜越近日出，安娜的家园就显得越陌生。

paras.en: Knobby branches twisted every which way, as if a forest of shadows had taken root in the land.
paras.zh: 疙疙瘩瘩的枝桠四处扭结，仿佛一片影之森林在大地上生了根。

paras.en: And overhead, a great sandstorm spun, its center positioned directly over Arendelle Castle.
paras.zh: 头顶上，一场巨大的沙暴盘旋着，中心正悬在阿伦黛尔城堡上方。

paras.en: Its great winds raised up high waves, and Anna and the rest of the crew covered their noses and mouths with the silk scarves that were originally meant to be gifts to the court of Corona, but now acted as shields so that they could breathe without inhaling sand as the royal ship glided closer.
paras.zh: 狂风吹起高高的浪，安娜和其余船员用丝巾捂住口鼻——那些丝巾本是要送给科罗纳（Corona）宫廷的礼物，此刻却成了盾牌，好让他们在皇家船滑近时，能喘气而不吸入沙子。

paras.en: Oaken steered the ship while Tuva barked commands at Wael, and SoYun and Anna helped with a complicated system of ropes and pulleys.
paras.zh: 奥肯掌舵，图娃朝威尔厉声发令，苏允和安娜则帮着操作一套复杂的绳索与滑轮系统。

paras.en: Wael looked a little green around the gills, and Anna was grateful that she herself had a strong stomach.
paras.zh: 威尔的脸色有点发青，安娜暗自庆幸自己肠胃够硬。

paras.en: But it was Olaf, a snowman who was used to falling apart and rolling in several directions at once, who was the biggest help.
paras.zh: 可最大的助力，是雪宝——这个习惯散了架、朝好几个方向同时滚的雪人。

paras.en: He made sure that the items on deck didn’t slam into anybody and that the still-sleeping Sven stayed safely out of harm’s way. “Sharp turn!” Oaken warned, and the next second, he’d turned the royal ship to be parallel to the castle gates.
paras.zh: 他确保甲板上的物件不撞到任何人，也让仍在沉睡的斯文安稳地避开了危险。“急转！”奥肯警告，下一秒，他便把皇家船转得与城堡大门平行。

paras.en: But there was still a sizable distance between the ship’s deck and land. “This is as close as we can get without smashing the ship!” Oaken called.
paras.zh: 可甲板与陆地之间仍隔着一段不小的距离。“再近就要撞船了，只能到这儿！”奥肯喊。

paras.en: Anna stared down at the choppy gray water.
paras.zh: 安娜俯视汹涌的灰水。

paras.en: Black sand sullied its usually white foam.
paras.zh: 黑沙玷污了本该雪白的浪沫。

paras.en: She’d have to jump!
paras.zh: 她得跳过去！

paras.en: But then she saw SoYun’s rope.
paras.zh: 可接着她看见了苏允的绳。

paras.en: Remembering how she’d escaped the Nattmara from Sorenson’s tower, she called to SoYun to throw the rope and latch it securely to a streetlamp.
paras.zh: 想起自己曾怎样从索伦森的塔楼逃脱纳特玛拉，她喊苏允把绳抛来，牢牢系在一盏路灯上。

paras.en: When it was done, Anna clambered up onto the top rail. “Wish me luck!” She took the free end of the rope from SoYun—and jumped!
paras.zh: 系好后，安娜爬上最高栏杆。“祝我好运！”她从苏允手里接过绳头——跳了下去！

paras.en: Three long seconds passed as she soared into the air and over the water, and then, let go.
paras.zh: 足足三秒，她飞过空中、越过水面，然后松了手。

paras.en: With a thump, she landed on the castle grounds.
paras.zh: 砰的一声，她落在城堡的地面上。

paras.en: Anna winced, not because of the pain, but because she should have made a quieter entrance.
paras.zh: 安娜缩了下身，不为疼，而是她本该更悄无声息地进场。

paras.en: Two pairs of glowing yellow eyes suddenly appeared at the front entrance to Arendelle Castle: Kai and Gerda.
paras.zh: 两对发光的黄眼忽然出现在阿伦黛尔城堡正门前：是凯（Kai）和格达。

paras.en: And their hair, too, had turned snow-white.
paras.zh: 他们的头发，也都变成了雪白。

paras.en: They still opened their mouths in a scream, but only a rasp came out.
paras.zh: 他们仍张嘴尖叫，却只发出嘶哑的气音。

paras.en: Anna shook her head in sorrow.
paras.zh: 安娜悲伤地摇了摇头。

paras.en: Kai and Gerda had been trapped in a screaming nightmare reality for almost three whole days.
paras.zh: 凯和格达已被困在那尖叫的噩梦现实里，快整整三天了。

paras.en: It was a wonder they had any voice left at all.
paras.zh: 他们竟还剩一点声音，简直是奇迹。

paras.en: Unfortunately, they still seemed able—and eager—to wield their household weapons.
paras.zh: 可惜，他们似乎仍能使——且急于使——他们的家什武器。

paras.en: The glint of Kai’s fire poker and Gerda’s sharp scissors still cut through the black sand.
paras.zh: 凯的拨火棒与格达的尖剪刀，寒光仍穿透黑沙。

paras.en: What to do what to do what to do! “Hoo-hoo, yellow-eyed wolf helpers!” Oaken called as he swung over the water and landed with surprising ease next to Anna. “It’s not polite to attack guests!” “Oaken!
paras.zh: 怎么办怎么办怎么办！“嗬——嗬，黄眼狼帮手！”奥肯荡过水面，出人意料地轻松落在安娜身旁，喊道，“攻击客人可不礼貌！”“奥肯！”

paras.en: Get back on the ship!” Anna instructed. “It’s not safe!” “Don’t worry, Anna,” Oaken said with a nod to the ship where Wael, SoYun, Tuva, and Olaf were calling out to Kai and Gerda from the deck, distracting them from Anna. “We’ve got this, ja ?
paras.zh: 回船上去！”安娜吩咐，“不安全！”“别担心，安娜，”奥肯朝船上点点头——威尔、苏允、图娃和雪宝正从甲板喊着凯和格达，引开他们对安娜的注意，“我们应付得来，对吧？”

paras.en: We’ll lure them away and make sure they don’t come to any harm—or cause any.
paras.zh: 我们会把他们引开，确保他们不受伤——也不伤人。

paras.en: Now, go help Elsa!” He turned to Kai and Gerda, and waved his arms. “Over here!” Anna nodded her thanks and rushed inside to find her sister…if there was anything left of her.
paras.zh: 现在，快去帮艾莎！”他转向凯和格达，挥舞手臂，“这儿！”安娜点头致谢，冲进城堡去找妹妹……若她还剩什么的话。

paras.en: She didn’t have a solid plan, but she was brave, and she had hope.
paras.zh: 她没有周全的计划，可她勇敢，且有希望。

paras.en: And that would have to be enough.
paras.zh: 那便足够了。

paras.en: The sand seemed thickest near the entry of the Great Hall, so Anna ran there as fast as she could on the strange combination of sand and hardwood.
paras.zh: 大会堂（Great Hall）入口附近的沙子似乎最厚，于是安娜在沙子与硬木混成的怪异地面上，拼命朝那儿跑去。

paras.en: It slowed her progress, but still Anna pushed forward toward the double doors.
paras.zh: 这拖慢了她的脚步，可安娜仍朝那两扇大门推进。

paras.en: Sure enough, as she drew closer, she could hear sobs.
paras.zh: 果然，越近，她越能听见啜泣。

paras.en: Shoving the doors open, Anna raced in.
paras.zh: 安娜推开大门，冲了进去。

paras.en: Her sister sat on her throne, her yellow eyes staring unblinking into a dream that Anna could not see.
paras.zh: 妹妹坐在王座上，黄眼一眨不眨地盯着一场安娜看不见的梦。

paras.en: As Elsa wept, strange flurries of black ice circled above her head.
paras.zh: 艾莎哭泣时，一团团古怪的黑冰在她头顶盘旋。

paras.en: Anna’s heart squeezed. “Elsa?” she whispered. “Elsa?” But her sister’s expression didn’t change.
paras.zh: 安娜的心一紧。“艾莎？”她低声唤，“艾莎？”可妹妹的神情毫无变化。

paras.en: Not wanting to startle Elsa, Anna slowly moved toward her.
paras.zh: 安娜不想惊到艾莎，慢慢朝她挪去。

paras.en: Suddenly, from the corner of the room, she heard a long, low growl.
paras.zh: 忽然，从房间一角，她听见一声悠长低沉的咆哮。

paras.en: It was happening again!
paras.zh: 又来了！

paras.en: Her nightmare!
paras.zh: 她的噩梦！

paras.en: It prowled out from behind the pillar—and attacked.
paras.zh: 它从柱子后潜出——扑了上来。

paras.en: But Anna was prepared.
paras.zh: 可安娜有备而来。

paras.en: She’d left her cloak unclasped for this very reason.
paras.zh: 她正是为此，才没扣上披风。

paras.en: And as the wolf leapt at her again, Anna flung her cloak off her shoulders and for the first time, instead of running away from the wolf, she ran toward it.
paras.zh: 当狼再次扑向她，安娜把披风从肩头甩下，第一次，她没有逃离狼，而是朝它奔去。

paras.en: She held her cloak above her head like a banner as she sprinted between its two front paws, each one as large as a boulder.
paras.zh: 她把披风举过头顶像面旗帜，从狼两只前爪间冲过——每只都有巨石那么大。

paras.en: The wolf realized a moment too late its prey’s route.
paras.zh: 狼迟了一瞬，才看清猎物的路线。

paras.en: Its teeth snapped down around the cloak, catching only fabric as Anna let go of it and raced under the protection of the wolf’s belly.
paras.zh: 它的牙咬向披风，只咬到布料——安娜已撒手，从狼腹的庇护下冲过。

paras.en: Holding her breath, she paused just long enough to hear the shred of cloth as the Nattmara’s teeth ripped the cloak, not quite yet realizing it was only a decoy.
paras.zh: 她屏住呼吸，停得恰够听见布料被撕碎的声——纳特玛拉的牙扯裂披风，还没意识到那只是诱饵。

paras.en: The charade would not last long, but it had bought her precious seconds.
paras.zh: 这戏法撑不了多久，却为她换来宝贵的几秒。

paras.en: Scurrying out from under the wolf’s tail, Anna hurled herself toward the throne.
paras.zh: 安娜从狼尾下窜出，朝王座扑去。

paras.en: Twelve feet left.
paras.zh: 还剩十二尺。

paras.en: Six.
paras.zh: 六尺。

paras.en: Three.
paras.zh: 三尺。

paras.en: She was almost there!
paras.zh: 她快到了！

paras.en: Arooooooooooooo!
The Nattmara had realized she had tricked it!
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉发现自己被骗了！

paras.en: Anna’s blood turned cold as she glanced back.
paras.zh: 安娜回头一瞥，血都凉了。

paras.en: She shouldn’t have.
paras.zh: 她本不该看。

paras.en: Because the wolf was upon her.
paras.zh: 因为狼已经扑到她身上。

paras.en: Claws the length of butcher’s knives raked across her back.
paras.zh: 如屠刀般长的利爪从她背上掠过。

paras.en: She squeezed her eyes shut, waiting for the pain…but it never came.
paras.zh: 她紧闭双眼，等着痛楚……可它没来。

paras.en: In fact, Anna didn’t feel a thing .
paras.zh: 事实上，安娜什么感觉都没有。

paras.en: Her eyes flew open just in time to see the Nattmara attack her again, but instead of colliding with her, it sailed right through Anna as though she were the one made of sand instead of the wolf.
paras.zh: 她猛地睁眼，正好看见纳特玛拉再次攻来，可它没撞上她，而是从安娜身上穿了过去——仿佛由沙做成的是她，而非狼。

paras.en: Her heart slammed into her chest.
paras.zh: 她的心猛撞胸口。

paras.en: She hadn’t felt any pain.
paras.zh: 她没感到任何痛。

paras.en: Had she become a ghost?
paras.zh: 她成了幽灵吗？

paras.en: The Nattmara snarled, clearly as confused as she was.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉低吼，显然和她一样困惑。

paras.en: It lunged again, this time teeth first, but Anna felt nothing more than a light breeze as its fangs grazed her throat, leaving not a scratch.
paras.zh: 它又扑来，这次牙在前，可安娜只觉一阵微风——獠牙擦过她的喉咙，没留下一丝抓痕。

paras.en: Like wind grasping at her.
paras.zh: 像风攥着她。

paras.en: And for the first time, Anna didn’t feel the suffocating pull of the Nattmara on her thoughts, making her think terrifying and helpless things.
paras.zh: 而第一次，安娜没感到纳特玛拉对她思绪那令人窒息的拉扯，逼她想那些可怕而无助的事。

paras.en: Again, and again, the Nattmara attacked her, but nothing it did could hurt her.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉一次次攻她，可它做什么都伤不了她。

paras.en: Anna’s mind whirled at a frantic pace.
paras.zh: 安娜的思绪疯狂打转。

paras.en: Whenever she had been around the Nattmara before, thoughts of not being good enough had filled her and held her down.
paras.zh: 从前她在纳特玛拉身边时，总被‘自己不够好’的念头填满、拖住。

paras.en: But now—now Anna knew, recalling the proclamation in Elsa’s traveling study, that she was good enough, and that she had always been.
paras.zh: 可现在——如今安娜想起艾莎巡游书房里那份公告，知道了自己够好，且一直都够好。

paras.en: The truth in those inked words seemed to have mended the cracks in her heart.
paras.zh: 那些墨字里的真相，似已修补了她心上的裂缝。

paras.en: She was no longer afraid.
paras.zh: 她不再害怕。

paras.en: The Nattmara could no longer harm her…so why was Anna’s nightmare still there?
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉再也伤不了她……可安娜的噩梦为何还在？

paras.en: Anna couldn’t concentrate!
paras.zh: 安娜无法集中精神！

paras.en: Elsa’s scream dug at her, and though the Nattmara’s fearsome claws could not hurt her anymore, each time Elsa wailed, Anna felt as though she’d been physically punched. “Elsa!” Anna cried, staggering toward the throne. “Whatever you’re seeing, it isn’t real!
paras.zh: 艾莎的尖叫刺着她，尽管纳特玛拉可怕的爪已伤不了她，可每次艾莎哀嚎，安娜都像被当面揍了一拳。“艾莎！”安娜踉跄着朝王座喊，“不管你看见什么，那都不是真的！”

paras.en: It’s just a nightmare!” Her thoughts dashed frantically, and she grabbed onto one before it slid by. “Remember Mother and Father!” she said. “Hot chocolate!
paras.zh: 只是个噩梦！”她的思绪慌乱奔窜，她抓住一个不让它溜走。“记得爸爸妈妈吗！”她说，“热可可！”

paras.en: Cozy stories—” Anna broke off.
paras.zh: 温馨的故事——”安娜顿住了。

paras.en: Wait a second.
paras.zh: 等一下。

paras.en: Pretending to give her nightmares to Frigg the Fisherman had never helped Anna.
paras.zh: 假装把噩梦交给渔夫弗里格（Frigg the Fisherman），从没帮过安娜。

paras.en: But now she recalled Elsa’s words from two days earlier.
paras.zh: 可如今她想起艾莎两天前的话。

paras.en: Mother’s trick worked for me.
paras.zh: 妈妈的办法对我管用。

paras.en: I haven’t had a nightmare since.
paras.zh: 从那以后我就没做过噩梦。

paras.en: Another thought darted by, this time, a memory of Sorenson’s voice, and his confusing words suddenly had meaning: The act of burying fear is what manifests the Nattmara , he’d said.
paras.zh: 又一个念头闪过，这次是索伦森声音的记忆，他那些费解的话忽然有了意义：正是埋藏恐惧，才显化了纳特玛拉，他曾这样说。

paras.en: And now Anna understood.
paras.zh: 如今安娜懂了。

paras.en: Fear only grew the longer it was ignored.
paras.zh: 恐惧越被忽视，就长得越大。

paras.en: Avoiding a nightmare only made it more powerful, more terrifying when it finally erupted again.
paras.zh: 躲避噩梦，只会让它在终于再度爆发时，更加强大、更加可怕。

paras.en: And if Elsa had ignored her fears for years—if she had banished her nightmares away, then maybe they had taken on their own life, taken on their own shape….
paras.zh: 若艾莎多年来一直忽视自己的恐惧——若她把噩梦驱逐出去，那么它们或许已有了自己的生命、自己的形状……

paras.en: Ulf the Wolf was always my favorite, Elsa had said in Sorenson’s tower.
paras.zh: ‘狼崽乌尔夫（Ulf the Wolf）一直是我的最爱，’艾莎曾在索伦森的塔里说过。

paras.en: What if, instead of handing her nightmares over to a friendly fisherman as Anna had tried, Elsa had imagined feeding her fears to a hungry wolf?
paras.zh: 如果，艾莎没像安娜那样把噩梦交给和善的渔夫，而是想象把恐惧喂给一头饥饿的狼呢？

paras.en: Anna’s ideas came to her even quicker.
paras.zh: 安娜的念头来得更快了。

paras.en: Elsa’s rejected nightmares and fears, unable to latch onto Elsa but more powerful than most people’s fears, had weaseled their way into another scared, lonely child’s dreams—a child whose loneliness had gaped wide within her, leaving room for black sand and dark dreams to creep into her heart.
