paras.zh: 艾莎那些被拒斥的噩梦与恐惧，既抓不住艾莎，又比多数人的恐惧更强大，便钻进了另一个惊恐、孤独的孩子梦里——那孩子的孤独在她心里张着大口，腾出地方让黑沙与暗梦潜入她的心。

paras.en: A heart that had cracked when the child had been separated from her sister.
paras.zh: 那颗心，在孩子的妹妹被带走时碎裂了。

paras.en: Anna’s heart.
paras.zh: 安娜的心。

paras.en: Realization thundered through her: Anna had not created the Nattmara—not with a spell or her own great worries.
paras.zh: 顿悟如雷贯耳：安娜并没有造出纳特玛拉——不是用咒语，也不是靠她自己的大忧虑。

paras.en: The wolf that had first appeared to her on that night sixteen years ago was not a manifestation of Anna’s fear.
paras.zh: 十六年前那夜初次现身的狼，并非安娜恐惧的显化。

paras.en: There had been another scared and lonely child in the castle beside her then, one who had also feared being separated from her sister: Elsa .
paras.zh: 那时城堡里，她身边还有另一个惊恐孤独的孩子，也同样怕与妹妹分离：艾莎。

paras.en: The Nattmara was Elsa’s nightmare!
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉，是艾莎的噩梦！

paras.en: It was Elsa’s fear that they needed to conquer!
paras.zh: 他们需要征服的，是艾莎的恐惧！

paras.en: But…Anna had no idea what her sister was afraid of.
paras.zh: 可……安娜完全不知妹妹在怕什么。

paras.en: Elsa was the strongest person she knew, a great queen, brave in the face of danger, determined, and regal.
paras.zh: 艾莎是她认识的最坚强的人，伟大的女王，临危不惧，坚定而威严。

paras.en: What to do what to do what to do!
paras.zh: 怎么办怎么办怎么办！

paras.en: The Nattmara, frustrated by its futile attempts to inflict harm to Anna, let out an earsplitting howl.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉因屡次伤安娜不成而挫败，发出一声刺耳的嚎叫。

paras.en: The sandstorm whipped up faster.
paras.zh: 沙暴卷得更急。

paras.en: While Anna might be safe from the beast’s attacks, Arendelle was not.
paras.zh: 安娜或许能躲过这怪兽的攻击，阿伦黛尔却躲不过。

paras.en: Anna ran toward Elsa, and though her stomach hurt as she looked at Elsa’s yellow eyes, she didn’t look away.
paras.zh: 安娜朝艾莎跑去，尽管望见艾莎的黄眼让她心口作痛，她却没有移开目光。

paras.en: The Nattmara had only come when they’d been separated—either by their parents when they were young, or by Elsa’s queenly responsibilities.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉只在她们分离时才来——无论是幼时被父母分开，还是被艾莎的女王职责分开。

paras.en: So it would only be defeated, Anna guessed wildly, when they were together.
paras.zh: 所以它只会在她们在一起时被击败，安娜大胆猜测。

paras.en: All Anna needed to figure out was what scared Elsa—but she truly had no idea what that could be. “Elsa!” she cried as she approached the throne. “Elsa, I’m here!
paras.zh: 安娜只需弄明白艾莎在怕什么——可她真的一点头绪都没有。“艾莎！”她逼近王座喊，“艾莎，我在这儿！”

paras.en: What’s wrong?
paras.zh: 怎么了？

paras.en: What are you so scared of that you can’t tell me?” Elsa just screamed harder, and the rush of black sand still spilling from her palms came quicker.
paras.zh: 你到底在怕什么，连都不肯告诉我？”艾莎只叫得更响，从她掌心涌出的黑沙更急了。

paras.en: It began to pile into a barrier between them, filling up the Great Hall.
paras.zh: 黑沙开始堆成一道隔在她们之间的屏障，填满了大会堂。

paras.en: Eventually, it would reach the rafters, and then the ceiling, burying Elsa on her throne.
paras.zh: 最终，它会堆到房梁，再堆到天花板，把王座上的艾莎埋起来。

paras.en: Wait a minute—the throne!
paras.zh: 等等——王座！

paras.en: They were in the Great Hall; the Nattmara had chosen it, so it must be Elsa’s least favorite room in the castle.
paras.zh: 她们在大礼堂；纳特玛拉选了这里，那它必是艾莎在城堡里最不喜欢的房间。

paras.en: And as Anna looked at the flurry of sand circling Elsa’s throne, spiraling up above her head to form a glittering crown of darkness, the answer came to her: Elsa was scared of being a bad queen. “The people are all counting on me!” Elsa sobbed in her nightmare-scape. “Please!
paras.zh: 安娜望着绕着艾莎王座盘旋、在她头顶卷成黑暗闪亮王冠的沙，答案浮上心头：艾莎怕自己是个坏女王。“子民们都指望着我！”艾莎在她的梦魇里啜泣，“求求！”

paras.en: I’ll be better!” Anna, no longer afraid of the Nattmara—but much more afraid of losing her sister forever—sprinted up the dais and grabbed Elsa’s hand.
paras.zh: “我会做得更好！”安娜不再怕纳特玛拉——却更怕永远失去妹妹——冲上高台，抓住艾莎的手。

paras.en: Elsa yanked it away from her, but Anna held tight.
paras.zh: 艾莎把手抽开，可安娜握得死紧。

paras.en: Suddenly, Anna could see into Elsa’s nightmare: the endless meetings that Elsa felt awkward leading, not knowing what to say to people after having had very little social interaction for most of her life.
paras.zh: 忽然，安娜能窥见艾莎的噩梦：那些艾莎觉得领导起来尴尬的没完没了的会议，大半生极少社交的她，不知该对人们说些什么。

paras.en: Anna had always just thought Elsa was a good listener.
paras.zh: 安娜一直只当艾莎是个好听众。

paras.en: Everyone seemed to think she was so wonderfully collected, but in truth, her quietness wasn’t composed thinking, but a deer-in-the-path-of-an-arrow kind of fright.
paras.zh: 人人都以为她从容镇定，可其实，她的安静不是沉着的思虑，而是如鹿直面箭矢般的惊惶。

paras.en: And the Nattmara had made her a bad queen—with the Blight.
paras.zh: 而纳特玛拉借枯萎病，把她变成了一个坏女王。

paras.en: It all made sense to Anna now.
paras.zh: 如今安娜全明白了。

paras.en: Before the Nattmara had the strength to take on the physical shape of a wolf, it had seeped into the kingdom as a sickness, stalking the kingdom the same way it had stalked Elsa’s mind.
paras.zh: 在纳特玛拉积蓄力量、化作狼的实体之前，它已作为一场病渗进王国，像跟踪艾莎的心一样跟踪着王国。

paras.en: And with the Blight came the people’s constant worry and questions, and Elsa had become more overwhelmed and even more fearful that she could not protect them.
paras.zh: 随着枯萎病而来的，是百姓不绝的忧虑与质问，艾莎越发难以承受，更怕自己护不住他们。

paras.en: She had begun to crack at the seams while trying to keep it all inside.
paras.zh: 她拼命把一切压在心里，却已开始从缝里裂开。

paras.en: She had not been able to sleep…and so, Elsa’s suppressed nightmares had found another sleeping, worried sister to haunt until, at last, the fear in Arendelle—Elsa’s fear—had grown so great and powerful that the Nattmara could at last be seen by everyone.
paras.zh: 她睡不着……于是艾莎被压抑的噩梦，找到了另一个沉睡而忧心的妹妹来纠缠，直到最后，阿伦黛尔的恐惧——艾莎的恐惧——长得如此巨大强悍，纳特玛拉终于能被所有人看见。

paras.en: Because above all, Elsa feared hurting the kingdom—again.
paras.zh: 因为说到底，艾莎最怕的，是再次伤害王国。

paras.en: Of hurting Anna, again. “Oh, Elsa,” Anna whispered, her heart aching. “Why didn’t you just tell me?” Anna held on to her sister’s hands, even as black sand pelted them from all around. “You’re perfect just the way you are!
paras.zh: 是再次伤害安娜。“噢，艾莎，”安娜低语，心头作痛，“你为什么不告诉我？”安娜紧紧握着妹妹的手，尽管黑沙从四面八方砸来，“你现在的样子就完美无缺！”

paras.en: You’re a great leader!
paras.zh: 你是伟大的领袖！

paras.en: You pay attention to details, and your quietness gives you space to listen.
paras.zh: 你注重细节，你的安静给了你倾听的空间。

paras.en: I’m so proud of you, Elsa.
paras.zh: 我为你骄傲，艾莎。

paras.en: You’re a wonderful sister, and you’re a role model for me.
paras.zh: 你是极好的妹妹，也是我的榜样。

paras.en: You’re someone I look up to!” Was it just Anna’s imagination, or was her sister now squeezing her hand back?
paras.zh: 你是我仰望的人！”这只是安娜的想象，还是妹妹此刻正回握她的手？

paras.en: Ignoring the thrum of the Nattmara’s anger around them in the form of black sand spraying Anna’s face from all sides, Anna continued to talk, focusing all of herself on her sister—letting her know how she felt about her, just in the same way Elsa’s proclamation had shown Anna the truth. “You know that I am better than who I think I am!” she yelled over the wind and battering sand. “I was so scared that you didn’t need me anymore since I wasn’t invited on the grand tour.
paras.zh: 无视纳特玛拉的怒意在四周化作黑沙喷向安娜的脸，安娜继续述说，把全部自己都聚焦在妹妹身上——让她知道自己有多在乎她，正如艾莎的公告曾让安娜看见真相。“你知道我比自以为的更好！”她在风与扑面的沙中喊，“我好怕你不再需要我，因为我没被邀去大巡游。”

paras.en: But then I saw that the tour had nothing to do with me, and I realized that you are right—I am helpful, and I am always here for you and for our people, no matter what!
paras.zh: 可后来我明白，巡游与我无关，也意识到你是对的——我有用，无论何时，我都为你、为我们的百姓守在这里！”

paras.en: Just as I know you are here for me!” Anna wasn’t sure if she was getting through to Elsa, but still she hung on, despite the growing swarm of assaulting black sand.
paras.zh: 正如我知道你也为我守在这里！”安娜不确定自己是否说进了艾莎心里，可她仍紧握不放，任凭越来越密的黑沙袭来。

paras.en: Elsa’s eyes shut tight.
paras.zh: 艾莎的眼紧闭。

paras.en: And then…“Anna?” “Elsa!” Anna cried. “I’m here!
paras.zh: 接着……“安娜？”“艾莎！”安娜喊，“我在这儿！”

paras.en: I’m always here!” Elsa turned her head, and Anna saw that her eyes were no longer yellow, but back to their usual beautiful shade of light blue. “Anna,” Elsa said, voice raspy from all the nightmare-induced screaming. “Of course I need you.” The Nattmara threw back its head and howled in rage, the sound echoing endlessly around the hall.
paras.zh: 我永远在这儿！”艾莎转过头，安娜看见她的眼睛不再是黄色，而恢复了惯常那美丽的浅蓝。“安娜，”艾莎说，因噩梦里的尖叫而嗓音沙哑，“我当然需要你。”纳特玛拉仰头怒嚎，声在厅中久久回荡。

paras.en: Elsa clutched tight to Anna’s hand. “Why is it still here?” Elsa whirled her other hand up, ready to blast it with ice. “No!” Anna shouted. “You can’t fight your fear—it only makes it stronger!
paras.zh: 艾莎紧攥安娜的手。“它怎么还在？”艾莎扬起另一只手，准备用冰轰它。“不！”安娜喊，“你不能和恐惧对抗——那只会让它更强！”

paras.en: Just as you can’t ignore your fear, because out of sight, it grows in strange ways and mutates.” “Then what should I do?” Elsa asked, her voice cracking. “Dawn is almost here!” “Accept it,” Anna breathed, praying she was right. “It’s okay to be afraid, Elsa.
paras.zh: 正如你也不能无视恐惧，因为看不见它，它就会以奇怪的方式生长、变异。”“那我该怎么办？”艾莎问，声音发颤，“黎明快到了！”“接纳它，”安娜轻声说，祈祷自己是对的，“害怕没关系，艾莎。”

paras.en: You just can’t let the fear take control of you!
paras.zh: 你只是不能让恐惧掌控你！

paras.en: Fear is the shadow of love.
paras.zh: 恐惧，是爱的影子。

paras.en: You only fear because you care so much about Arendelle and about me, and that’s what makes you a great queen and a great leader.
paras.zh: 你之所以怕，是因为你太在乎阿伦黛尔、太在乎我，而那正是让你成为伟大女王与领袖的缘由。

paras.en: And a great sister.
paras.zh: 也是伟大的妹妹。

paras.en: That’s why we love you, Elsa.” It was the riddle that Olaf had helped her solve when he had rearranged the letters of the sword.
paras.zh: “那正是我们爱你，艾莎的原因。”这正是雪宝重排剑上字母时帮她解开的谜。

paras.en: Not R-E-V-O-L-U-T-E or L-O-V-E R-E-T-U , but T-R-U-E L-O-V-E was the way to defeat the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 不是 R-E-V-O-L-U-T-E，也不是 L-O-V-E R-E-T-U，而是 T-R-U-E L-O-V-E（真爱）才是击败纳特玛拉之道。

paras.en: And that was a thing of myth.
paras.zh: 而那，是件神话之物。

paras.en: Elsa didn’t say anything, but then she held out her hand again.
paras.zh: 艾莎没说什么，却再次伸出手。

paras.en: The giant wolf paused, the winds calmed down, and with each step the wolf took toward the sisters, it grew smaller.
paras.zh: 巨狼顿住，风静了下来，狼每朝姐妹俩走近一步，就缩小一分。

paras.en: By the time it reached Elsa’s outstretched hand, the wolf was the size of a little wolf-puppy.
paras.zh: 等它走到艾莎伸出的手边，已小得像只狼崽。

paras.en: It still had sharp teeth and claws, but it was manageable and could be contained. “My fear,” Elsa said in awe. “I was so afraid of being a bad queen, but I don’t need to worry about that anymore.
paras.zh: 它仍有尖牙利爪，却已可控、可容纳。“我的恐惧，”艾莎敬畏地说，“我曾那么怕做个坏女王，可如今不必再担心了。”

paras.en: Because I’ve got you, Anna.” Anna smiled and stayed put as the white wolf pup approached.
paras.zh: “因为我有你，安娜。”安娜微笑着不动，任那白色狼崽走近。

paras.en: She wasn’t scared of Elsa’s fear—it was a part of her sister, and she could never be afraid of her.
paras.zh: 她不怕艾莎的恐惧——那是妹妹的一部分，而她永远不会对妹妹感到害怕。

paras.en: The Nattmara’s power was truly done at last.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉的力量，终于彻底消散了。

paras.en: The puppy touched its nose to Elsa’s hand and turned into a cloud of sand, shimmering in the air, and then…just a single grain of black sand lay before the sisters.
paras.zh: 狼崽用鼻子碰了碰艾莎的手，化作一团沙，在空中微光闪烁，接着……姐妹面前只余一粒黑沙。

paras.en: With a flick of her wrist, Elsa captured it in an ice crystal and caught it in her hand.
paras.zh: 艾莎手腕一甩，将那粒沙封进冰晶，握在手里。

paras.en: Then she held it up to the dawn’s first ray of light. “How?” she breathed. “How did we defeat the Nattmara without a thing of myth?” “Because,” Anna said, peering at the crystal, “we do have a thing of myth—we’ve had it all along.
paras.zh: 接着她把冰晶举向黎明的第一缕光。“怎么会？”她轻叹，“没有神话之物，我们怎么打败了纳特玛拉？”“因为，”安娜盯着冰晶说，“我们确有神话之物——而且一直都有。”

paras.en: Aren didn’t become a myth because he just so happened to own a fancy sword.
paras.zh: 阿伦成为神话，不是因为他恰巧有把好剑。

paras.en: Swords and crowns don’t change who we are.” Elsa slipped the single grain of sand into her pocket. “Then what does?” “True love,” Anna said, referencing the hidden power that the Saga of Aren spoke of. “The power that carved out Arenfjord.
paras.zh: 剑与王冠，改变不了我们是谁。”艾莎把那粒沙塞进口袋。“那什么能？”“真爱，”安娜说，指的是《阿伦传奇》里说的隐秘力量，“那劈出阿伦峡湾的力量。”

paras.en: The same power that gave Aren the strength to go out in his boat to face an unknown danger, or up a mountain to face a dragon.
paras.zh: 也正是那股力量，让阿伦有勇气乘船出海直面未知的危险，或上山直面巨龙。

paras.en: It doesn’t matter which really happened—what matters is the choice he made.” Suddenly, it hit her how sleepy she was, and her thoughts came to her like a lap of quiet ocean waves. “It’s like how Sorenson said all myths contain a kernel of hard truth.
paras.zh: 究竟哪件真的发生过并不重要——重要的是他所做的选择。”忽然，她感到困意袭来，思绪如静海轻拍的微波涌来。“就像索伦森说的，所有神话都藏着一粒坚硬的真相。”

paras.en: It wasn’t a magical sword that carved out a home on the fjord.
paras.zh: 在峡湾边安家，靠的不是魔法剑。

paras.en: The myth wasn’t about the creation of the actual fjord—it was a myth about how, through love, Aren and the others in his generation believed in each other and trusted each other and loved each other enough to settle here and carve out a home for themselves, and for their future children, families, and friends.
paras.zh: 那神话讲的不是峡湾本身的诞生——而是关于：透过爱，阿伦与他同代的人如何彼此信任、彼此相爱，足以在此定居，为自己、也为将来的孩子、家人与朋友，开辟出一个家。

paras.en: For us.
paras.zh: 为我们。

paras.en: A place where Arendelle’s flags could always fly strong.” “True love,” Elsa mused. “The thing that can move mountains and defeat nightmares.” “Exactly,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 一个阿伦黛尔的旗帜永远高高飘扬的地方。”“真爱，”艾莎若有所思，“能移山、能击败噩梦的东西。”“正是，”安娜说。

paras.en: She led Elsa over to the window, to the curtain she’d first spotted the wolf hiding behind. “Our love is worthy of the great myths.
paras.zh: 她领艾莎走到窗边，那道她最初发现狼藏身的窗帘后。“我们的爱，配得上那些伟大的神话。”

paras.en: Us.
paras.zh: 我们。

paras.en: The royal sisters of Arendelle.” Anna pulled back the curtain.
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔的王室姐妹。”安娜拉开窗帘。

paras.en: Sunlight rushed in.
paras.zh: 阳光涌了进来。

paras.en: Dawn had fully broken, and the sun streaked across the horizon, brilliant gold in a gray-satin sky, shining down on a land full of vibrant color.
paras.zh: 黎明已完全破晓，太阳划过地平线，在灰缎般的天空里金光灿烂，照耀着一片色彩鲜活的大地。

paras.en: No trace of the angry black sand or deathly pale rot remained.
paras.zh: 愤怒的黑沙与死寂的苍白腐烂，再无半点痕迹。

paras.en: And as she squinted in the direction of the rising sun, Anna noticed a figure walking toward the castle.
paras.zh: 她眯眼朝初升太阳的方向望去，看见一个身影正朝城堡走来。

paras.en: There was something about the clothes and the shaggy hair that looked familiar…. “Kristoff!” Anna shouted.
paras.zh: 那衣着与蓬乱的头发，透着几分熟悉……“克里斯托夫！”安娜喊。

paras.en: Elsa rested a hand on Anna’s shoulder. “Go get him,” she said.
paras.zh: 艾莎把手搭在安娜肩上。“去迎接他，”她说。

paras.en: Anna grinned at her sister, then took off, flying into the second great hall and outside the castle, and then Kristoff was in her arms, kissing her again and again.
paras.zh: 安娜朝妹妹一笑，随即飞奔，穿过第二大会堂冲出城堡，然后克里斯托夫已在她怀里，一遍遍地吻她。

paras.en: She kissed him until the memories of the past few days faded away, and for the first time in a long time, she felt like everything was going to be good again.
paras.zh: 她吻着他，直到这几日的记忆淡去，许久以来第一次，她觉得一切都将好起来。

paras.en: With tears of joy streaming down her face, she took Kristoff’s face in her hands. “I’m so glad you’re okay,” she said. “You know I will always come back to you,” Kristoff said, giving her a playful wink. “Me too!” a new voice commented.
paras.zh: 喜悦的泪顺着脸滑落，她双手捧住克里斯托夫的脸。“你平安无事，我太高兴了，”她说。“你知道我总会回到你身边的，”克里斯托夫俏皮地眨眨眼。“我也是！”一个陌生的声音插话。

paras.en: Anna looked up to see Olaf sitting on Sven’s antlers.
paras.zh: 安娜抬头，看见雪宝坐在斯文的鹿角上。

paras.en: Sven’s fur was still mottled white, but his eyes were bright and shiny once again.
paras.zh: 斯文的毛仍斑驳地白着，眼睛却重新亮了起来。

paras.en: The smell of the sea lingered on his coat. “Sven!” Kristoff cried with delight.
paras.zh: 他毛上仍留着海的气息。“斯文！”克里斯托夫欣喜地喊。

paras.en: Planting one last kiss on Anna’s cheek, he hurried over to the reindeer and hugged him tight, while Sven nuzzled him back. “You’re finally awake!” He wiggled the reindeer’s lower lip and added in Sven Talk, “And you look like you’re half asleep.” “Group hug,” Elsa said as she approached, and she enveloped everyone in her arms.
paras.zh: 他在安娜脸颊上落下最后一吻，便赶去抱紧驯鹿，斯文也用鼻蹭着他。“你终于醒了！”他捏了捏鹿的下唇，用斯文语补道，“而且你看起来像半睡半醒。”“一起抱，”艾莎走近说，把所有人拥入怀中。

paras.en: And with a happy yawn, Anna leaned her head against Elsa’s shoulder as the village bells began to toll across the fjord, calling all to rise and wake.
paras.zh: 安娜幸福地打了个哈欠，把头靠在艾莎肩上，村落的钟声开始越过峡湾敲响，呼唤所有人起身、醒来。

paras.en: AUTUMN LEAVES BLAZED in a golden glory.
paras.zh: 秋叶燃成一片金辉。

paras.en: The sky was a blue so clear that when Anna looked up, she thought she could practically see the domed palace of the sun where Aren had supposedly retrieved Revolute.
paras.zh: 天空蓝得透亮，安娜抬头时，几乎觉得自己能看见太阳那穹顶般的宫殿——传说阿伦就是在那里取得回旋之刃的。

paras.en: She smiled to herself as she made her way through town back to Arendelle Castle, greeting everyone she saw. “Nice to see you, Baker Blodget!
paras.zh: 她一边穿过小镇回阿伦黛尔城堡，一边向每个遇见的人问好，暗自微笑。“见到你真高兴，面包师布洛杰特（Blodget）！”

paras.en: Good day to you, Gabriella!
paras.zh: “日安，加布里埃拉（Gabriella）！”

paras.en: Hello, Ada!” “Hello, Anna!” Tuva’s wife called from behind a cart of beautiful golden wheat.
paras.zh: “你好，阿达！”“你好，安娜！”图娃的妻子从一辆满载金色麦子的推车后喊道。

paras.en: Her hazel eyes sparkled.
paras.zh: 她淡褐色的眼睛闪闪发亮。

paras.en: Not a hint of yellow lupine eyes to be seen. “I’m glad to see you!” Anna said with a grin and a wave.
paras.zh: 不见半点黄眼（羽扇豆般的眼）的踪影。“真高兴见到你！”安娜咧嘴笑着挥手。

paras.en: She was practically skipping in her skirts. “We’ll have the best harvest festival ever tomorrow.” “I hope so,” SoYun said as she herded a healthy Hebert along the road.
paras.zh: 她几乎要提着裙摆跳起来。“明天的丰收节一定会是有史以来最棒的。”“但愿如此，”苏允赶着健壮的赫伯特（Hebert）沿路走时说。

paras.en: Madam Eniola curtsied, her arms laden with green zucchini. “I’m just glad the aphid outbreak that affected all my crops has cleared up.” Anna arranged her face into what she hoped was an understanding—and not in any way knowing—expression.
paras.zh: 埃尼奥拉（Eniola）夫人行了个屈膝礼，怀里抱满绿西葫芦。“我只高兴影响了我所有作物的蚜虫爆发总算过去了。”安娜摆出一副她希望显得体谅——且绝无知晓意味——的表情。

paras.en: It had been one month since the events of the Nattmara.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉事件已过去一个月。

paras.en: She wasn’t used to keeping secrets, and she didn’t particularly like it, but the villagers who’d fallen under the Nattmara’s enchantment had no memory about the danger they had all come so close to.
paras.zh: 她不习惯保守秘密，也不怎么喜欢，可那些曾陷在纳特玛拉魔障里的村民，对已逼近的危险毫无记忆。

paras.en: In fact, all it seemed anyone could remember—apart from SoYun, Wael, Tuva, Olaf, and Elsa—was a light aphid breakout on some of the crops that had coated the harvest in white scales.
paras.zh: 事实上，除了苏允、威尔、图娃、雪宝和艾莎，旁人似乎只记得部分庄稼上的一场轻微蚜虫爆发，给收成裹了层白壳。

paras.en: Even Kristoff and the others who hadn’t been under the Nattmara’s spell for all that long seemed to remember events differently.
paras.zh: 连克里斯托夫和其他没被纳特玛拉缠太久的人，对事件的记忆似乎也变了样。

paras.en: He recollected some of what had happened, but wasn’t able to parse out which memories had been real and which had been simply figments of his nightmare. “Extra, extra, read all about it!
paras.zh: 他记起了些发生的事，却分不清哪些记忆是真、哪些只是噩梦的碎片。“号外，号外，都来看！”

paras.en: Get your copy of the Village Crown !” Anna looked over to see Wael selling his newspaper.
paras.zh: “买一份《村庄之冠》（Village Crown）！”安娜转头，看见威尔在卖他的报纸。

paras.en: Already, he had a crowd of villagers gathered.
paras.zh: 他身旁已聚起一群村民。

paras.en: Many didn’t bother to wait before spreading open the paper and reading the day’s events right then and there.
paras.zh: 许多人等不及，当场就把报纸摊开读起当日新闻。

paras.en: She caught a glimpse of the current headline: “More Than Royal: Sisters Are True Friends of the Kingdom.” Anna grinned.
paras.zh: 她瞥见此刻的标题：“不止是王室：姐妹俩是王国真正的朋友。”安娜咧嘴笑了。

paras.en: Entering the castle, she took the steps three at a time, the letter she had picked up clutched in her fingers.
paras.zh: 进了城堡，她一步跨三级台阶，手里攥着刚取到的信。

paras.en: She went to Elsa’s council chambers and knocked.
paras.zh: 她走到艾莎的议事厅，敲了门。

paras.en: Six staccato raps followed by two spaced-out ones.
paras.zh: 六下短促的叩击，接着两下间隔的。

paras.en: Do you want to build a snowman? “Come in!” Elsa’s voice floated through the door.
paras.zh: 想堆雪人吗？“进来！”艾莎的声音飘过门来。

paras.en: So much had changed in the past month—at least, that’s how it felt to Anna, whose heart was much lighter than it had been in a long time.
paras.zh: 过去一个月里太多东西变了——至少安娜是这样觉得的，她的心比很久以来都轻快得多。

paras.en: But she knew things hadn’t really changed for Elsa.
paras.zh: 可她知道，对艾莎来说，事情其实并没变。

paras.en: After all, she still had to face the stress of leading the kingdom, and somehow, the stacks of papers seemed higher than ever before.
paras.zh: 毕竟，她仍要面对治理王国的压力，而那一摞摞文件，似乎比以往更高了。

paras.en: As Anna entered the council chambers, she saw that Elsa, as always, was leaning over her table, her long quill scratching away at the reams of parchment.
paras.zh: 安娜进议事厅时，看见艾莎一如往常伏在桌前，长羽笔在成卷的羊皮纸上沙沙写着。

paras.en: Elsa remembered the whole thing, as did Anna.
paras.zh: 整件事艾莎记得，安娜也记得。

paras.en: Anna suspected it was because her sister had been the reason the Nattmara came to Arendelle in the first place.
paras.zh: 安娜猜想，是因为妹妹本就是纳特玛拉当初降临阿伦黛尔的根源。

paras.en: It had been with both of them for much, much longer than a few nightmarish days.
paras.zh: 它伴随她们俩的时间，远不止那几个噩梦般的日子。

paras.en: It had been with them for practically their entire lives, and was not easily forgotten.
paras.zh: 它几乎伴随了她们整个一生，岂是轻易忘得掉的。

paras.en: Anna knew, too, that if Gerda or one of the royal handlers reached into the secret pocket sewn into the left sleeve of Elsa’s dress, they would find an ice crystal, perfect in its clarity except for the single grain of black sand at its center.
paras.zh: 安娜也知道，若格达或某位王室侍从伸手探入艾莎裙装左袖里缝的秘密口袋，会发现一枚冰晶，澄澈无瑕，唯独中心嵌着一粒黑沙。

paras.en: Elsa would keep it with her always, close to her heart, acknowledging it, allowing her fear to motivate her, but not letting it take control. “Elsa,” Anna said, flapping the letter under Elsa’s nose until her sister looked up from her paperwork. “Guess what I got!” Elsa propped her chin on her hand and smiled. “A letter.
paras.zh: 艾莎会永远把它带在身边，贴近心房，正视它，让恐惧成为动力，却不任它掌控。“艾莎，”安娜把信在妹妹鼻尖下晃，直到她从公文里抬起头，“猜我拿到了什么！”艾莎手托下巴笑道：“一封信。”

paras.en: I can see it in your hand.” Anna rolled her eyes. “Yes, okay, but guess from whom I got it!” But she didn’t bother to wait for Elsa’s guess and plopped it down onto the table. “Ugh, stop adding to my piles!
paras.zh: “我看见在你手里了。”安娜翻了个白眼。“是啦，可你猜是谁寄来的！”可她没等艾莎猜，便把信啪地放到桌上。“哎呀，别往我这堆里加了！”

paras.en: Wait a second,” she said as she read the address. “It’s from Sorenson?” Anna smiled. “It is!
paras.zh: “等等，”她读着地址说，“是索伦森寄来的？”安娜笑了。“没错！”

paras.en: He wants to come visit.
paras.zh: 他想来拜访。

paras.en: He says that he had a dream about us, and that he thought Mother would have liked for us to meet.” Anna liked the grumpy old man and was pleased he hadn’t come to any lasting damage after the Nattmara attack, though she still felt bad that his life’s work had been ruined on the observation deck of his tower.
paras.zh: 他说他梦到了我们，觉得妈妈会乐意让我们见上一面。”安娜喜欢这脾气古怪的老人，也欣慰他在纳特玛拉袭击后没留下永久创伤，尽管她仍为他的毕生心血毁于塔楼观测台而难过。

paras.en: She was looking forward to showing him the library in the castle, as well as the even bigger one down in the village.
paras.zh: 她盼着带他看城堡里的图书馆，还有村里那座更大的。

paras.en: And she was eager to find out what he would have to teach her about the stars and about seeking answers in the world around them—and about the secret room.
paras.zh: 也急切想知他会在星辰、在周遭世界里寻觅答案——以及那间密室——上教她些什么。

paras.en: If being Elsa’s sister weren’t a full-time job, Anna thought she might want to become a scientist herself one day.
paras.zh: 安娜想，若做艾莎的妹妹不是一份全职工作，说不定有朝一日她自己也想当个科学家。

paras.en: Elsa smiled.
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了。

paras.en: It was a true smile, if also a tired one. “Are you feeling better?” Anna asked. “Yes—actually, no,” Elsa said, catching herself.
paras.zh: 那是真心的笑，尽管也透着疲惫。“你好些了吗？”安娜问。“好些了——其实，没有，”艾莎说着，意识到自己的话。

paras.en: She was trying to be more honest with Anna—and herself—about what she was feeling. “I’ve been distracted of late.” “Perfect,” Anna said.
paras.zh: 她正试着对安娜——也对自己——更坦诚地面对感受。“我近来心不在焉。”“太好了，”安娜说。

paras.en: Elsa’s eyebrows rose in surprise. “Perfect?
paras.zh: 艾莎惊讶地挑眉。“太好了？”

paras.en: What do you mean?” “Because I know exactly how to help.
paras.zh: “什么意思？”“因为我知道该怎么帮你。”

paras.en: Come with me.” She led Elsa out of the room and into the library.
paras.zh: 跟我来。”她领艾莎出了房间，走进图书馆。

paras.en: There, Anna waltzed over to the horse statue and gave the hoof a tug.
paras.zh: 在那儿，安娜翩然走到马雕像前，拉了一下马蹄。

paras.en: The bookcase swung open to reveal the secret room, but this time, no dust flew into the air.
paras.zh: 书架旋开，露出密室，可这一次，没有灰尘飞扬。

paras.en: She beckoned Elsa inside, and smiled when she heard Elsa’s gasp of delight.
paras.zh: 她招手让艾莎进来，听见艾莎惊喜的抽气声，便笑了。

paras.en: When Elsa had been busy in the council chambers, Anna had been busy herself, prettying up the secret room and making it a fully cozy Elsa hideaway.
paras.zh: 艾莎在议事厅忙碌时，安娜也没闲着，她把密室收拾得漂漂亮亮，打造成一处完全舒适的艾莎小天地。

paras.en: She’d brought in more lanterns and settled comfy pillows around the floor, and even had the portrait of Aren restored.
paras.zh: 她添了更多灯笼，在地板四周铺了软垫，甚至把阿伦的画像修复了。

paras.en: It now hung prominently on the wall, Revolute shining at its center as a symbol of hope and a reminder of what actually shaped the world. “I know you’re tired and people keep interrupting you,” Anna said. “You give so much to the kingdom, but you need to take care of yourself, too.
paras.zh: 它如今醒目地挂在墙上，回旋之刃在正中闪亮，既是希望的象征，也提醒着真正塑造世界的是什么。“我知道你累了，又总被人打断，”安娜说，“你为王国付出那么多，可也得照顾好自己。”

paras.en: This can be a place for you to get away and just be you.
paras.zh: 这里可以是你躲开一切、只做自己的地方。

paras.en: Where you can rest and take a quiet moment to yourself, where no one will know where to find you.
paras.zh: 你可以在这儿歇息，独享片刻安宁，谁也找不到你。

paras.en: The past is in here, Elsa, but so is the future.
paras.zh: 过去在这里，艾莎，未来也在这里。

paras.en: I want you to remember that I will always believe in you.” “Thank you, Anna.” Elsa turned to give her younger sister a hug. “This is magnificent.” “And,” Anna said with a cheeky smile, “I’m reinstituting family game night.” Elsa twisted her lips into a wry smile. “I would like that, but I always have so much work…” “Sure.” Anna shrugged. “And it’s not going anywhere.” “Game night…” Elsa said, looking around at the notes, books, and records their parents had collected.
paras.zh: 我希望你记得，我永远相信你。”“谢谢你，安娜。”艾莎转身拥抱了妹妹，“这太棒了。”“还有，”安娜狡黠一笑，“我要恢复家庭游戏之夜。”艾莎嘴角弯起一抹无奈的笑。“我愿意，可我总有那么多事……”“没事，”安娜耸耸肩，“它又跑不了。”“游戏之夜……”艾莎环顾父母收集的笔记、书籍与记录，说道。

paras.en: Anna had carefully placed Secrets of the Magic Makers in the center of the worktable alongside their father’s sketchbook.
paras.zh: 安娜把《魔法制造者之秘》（Secrets of the Magic Makers）小心摆在工作台中央，旁边是父亲的速写本。

paras.en: Even though it didn’t contain any actual spells, Anna sensed that it was important.
paras.zh: 尽管里面并无真正的咒语，安娜仍感到它很重要。

paras.en: After all, every story held some truth. “Remember how we used play charades with Mother and Father?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 毕竟，每个故事都藏有真相。“记得我们和爸爸妈妈玩猜字谜吗？”艾莎问。

paras.en: Anna nodded. “You know,” she said, not sure how exactly to put her feelings into words, “I like this room because I can see a glimpse of who they were.
paras.zh: 安娜点点头。“你知道吗，”她说，不太确定该怎么把感受说清，“我喜欢这间屋子，因为我能窥见他们曾是怎样的人。”

paras.en: I feel like here maybe they’re not so lost to us after all.
paras.zh: 我觉得在这儿，他们或许终究没那么远离我们。

paras.en: Though I still wonder why they never told us about this room.
paras.zh: 虽然我还是纳闷，他们为何从没告诉我们这间屋子。

paras.en: And I wonder what they were looking for.
paras.zh: 也纳闷他们在找什么。

paras.en: And why Mother visited Sorenson.” “Maybe we can ask him when he comes to visit,” Elsa said. “But maybe,” she added, fiddling with her sleeve cuff, “they were looking at magic.
paras.zh: 还有妈妈为何去拜访索伦森。”“等他来拜访时，我们或许可以问他，”艾莎说，“不过也许，”她摆弄着袖口补充，“他们是在研究魔法。”

paras.en: What must they have thought of my having magic, when no one else does?
paras.zh: “当别人都没有魔法，而我却有，他们该作何感想？”

paras.en: I mean, I can create these magical, wonderful things.…” “Could be,” Anna said. “Speaking of your creations, I haven’t seen Olaf all day.
paras.zh: “我的意思是，我能造出这些神奇美妙的东西……”“有可能，”安娜说，“说到你的造物，我一整天都没见着雪宝。”

paras.en: Do you know where he is?” Elsa smiled. “I do.
paras.zh: 你知道他在哪儿吗？”艾莎笑了。“我知道。”

paras.en: And this time, I have a surprise for you .” “But it’s not my birthday,” Anna said, all the while running through a catalogue of things she could possibly be getting. “You’re not the only one who can plan a surprise,” Elsa said with a smile.
paras.zh: “而且这次，我给你准备了惊喜。”“可今天不是我生日啊，”安娜说，脑子里却已把可能收到的东西列了个遍。“会打算惊喜的不止你一个，”艾莎微笑着说。

paras.en: They dashed up to Anna’s favorite turret, and Elsa led her out onto the little balcony. “How did you find the time to plan a surprise?” Anna asked. “There,” Elsa said, pointing in the direction of the open sea. “What do you see?” Anna squinted.
paras.zh: 她们冲上安娜最喜欢的角楼，艾莎领她走到小阳台上。“你哪来的时间筹划惊喜？”安娜问。“那儿，”艾莎指向开阔的海面，“你看见了什么？”安娜眯起眼。

paras.en: She couldn’t be certain at first, but then…“Elsa!” She gasped. “Those are ships!
paras.zh: 起初她不敢确定，可接着……“艾莎！”她倒吸一口气，“那是船！”

paras.en: And they’re flying the royal flags of…Is that Zaria?
paras.zh: “它们挂着王室的旗帜……那是扎里亚（Zaria）吗？”

paras.en: And that one has the royal flag of Corona!
paras.zh: “那面挂着的是科罗纳的王室旗！”

paras.en: And the third one—that’s the flag of Eldora!” Elsa nodded. “Exactly right.
paras.zh: “第三艘——那是 Eldora 的旗！”艾莎点头，“完全正确。”

paras.en: The grand tour was cancelled, but the dignitaries understood.
paras.zh: 大巡游取消了，可各位使节都理解。

paras.en: So much so, that they accepted my invitation to visit Arendelle now that the gates are open.
paras.zh: 他们如此通情，竟接受了我的邀请，既然城门已开，便来阿伦黛尔做客。

paras.en: This way, neither one of us has to leave home, where we are both needed.” Anna’s grin felt so big that her cheeks couldn’t contain it.
paras.zh: 这样，我们谁都不必离开家乡——那里都需要我们。”安娜的笑容大得脸颊都盛不下。

paras.en: And as she looked down, watching the villagers meet the arriving visitors, Anna thought she saw a shiver in the shadows, and maybe, just maybe, a flick of a tail.
paras.zh: 她朝下望去，看村民迎接来客，忽觉阴影里有东西一动，或许，只是或许，是尾巴一甩。

paras.en: Anna waved down, and she could have sworn that she saw a small Hulder waving at her from the shoulders of a taller one before slipping away again.
paras.zh: 安娜朝下挥手，她发誓自己看见一个小胡尔德从更高的胡尔德肩头朝她挥手，随即又溜走了。

paras.en: There was a slam of the door, and then Anna heard a thumping on the stairs before Kristoff burst onto the balcony, Sven with Olaf on his back following in his wake. “Sorry!” Kristoff said. “I didn’t mean to be late.
paras.zh: 门砰地一声，接着安娜听见楼梯上咚咚的脚步，克里斯托夫冲上阳台，斯文背着雪宝跟在身后。“抱歉！”克里斯托夫说，“我不是故意迟到的。”

paras.en: I was having an argument with Sven about something I just brought back from the trolls!
paras.zh: “我刚从地精那儿带回来的东西，正跟斯文争呢！”

paras.en: He’s been funny lately.
paras.zh: “他最近怪怪的。”

paras.en: I keep thinking that he’s trying to tell me something—maybe about a ship?” He shrugged his shoulders. “But as far as I know, Sven’s never been on a ship.” Sven nudged Kristoff with his antlers while Anna and Elsa exchanged a look of surprise.
paras.zh: “我总觉得他想告诉我什么——或许是关于船？”他耸耸肩，“可据我所知，斯文从没上过船。”斯文用鹿角轻轻顶了顶克里斯托夫，安娜和艾莎交换了一个惊讶的眼神。

paras.en: Other than their small group, the others didn’t seem to remember the Nattmara—but maybe the animals did.
paras.zh: 除了他们这个小圈子，旁人似乎都不记得纳特玛拉——可动物们也许记得。

paras.en: Sven looked better than ever, Anna noticed.
paras.zh: 安娜注意到，斯文气色前所未有地好。

paras.en: His curly reindeer hair was back to a rich brown without any unusual sprinkling of white.
paras.zh: 他卷曲的鹿毛恢复了浓棕，再没有异常的白斑。

paras.en: The Nattmara hadn’t caused any lasting damage.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉没造成任何长久的伤害。

paras.en: In fact, it had taught Anna that Elsa didn’t have to be perfect, just as Anna didn’t have to be perfect.
paras.zh: 事实上，它教会了安娜：艾莎不必完美，正如安娜自己也不必完美。

paras.en: She could make mistakes—and to be honest, she would make mistakes.
paras.zh: 她会犯错——说实话，她确实会犯错。

paras.en: And that was okay.
paras.zh: 而那没关系。

paras.en: She had Elsa and Kristoff and Olaf to help her.
paras.zh: 她有艾莎、克里斯托夫和雪宝帮她。

paras.en: And the gates were open.
paras.zh: 而且城门已开。

paras.en: And yes, there were still secrets, there was still so much she didn’t know, but finding the answers to those questions would be an adventure…and she would not have to go on the journey alone.
paras.zh: 是的，仍有秘密，仍有太多她不知道的事，可寻找那些答案，会是场冒险……而这段旅程，她不必独自走。

paras.en: There was nothing to fear. “Look!” Olaf said, pointing toward a streak of light in the sky. “A chunk of space rock is falling through the atmosphere and burning up!” “Or,” Elsa said with a smile, “you could just say it’s a falling star.” “A shooting star,” Kristoff offered as he leaned against the rail and took Anna’s hand in his.
paras.zh: 没什么好怕的。“看！”雪宝指着天上一道流光说，“一块太空石头正穿过大气层烧起来！”“或者，”艾莎微笑着说，“你可以干脆说它是颗流星。”“流星，”克里斯托夫倚着栏杆、握住安娜的手，补了一句。

paras.en: She squeezed it back. “A wishing star,” she said.
paras.zh: 她回握了一下。“许愿星，”她说。

paras.en: But at that moment, standing with her friends, looking up at the brilliant light of the meteor shower arcing over Arendelle, Anna had nothing to wish for at all—because everything she could have wished for was right there beside her.
paras.zh: 可那一刻，安娜和朋友们站在一起，仰望划过阿伦黛尔的绚烂流星雨，她已一无祈求——因为她所能许愿的一切，都已在身边。

paras.en: ANNA DREAMED.
paras.zh: 安娜做了个梦。

paras.en: In the darkness, a single ember drifted.
paras.zh: 黑暗中，一粒火星飘荡。

paras.en: It tumbled endlessly through a void until, at last, it tangled in black branches.
paras.zh: 它无尽地翻滚过虚空，终于缠进了黑色的枝桠。

paras.en: It pulsed, once, twice, and then, the spark began to lengthen.
paras.zh: 它搏动了一下，两下，接着，那火花开始拉长。

paras.en: Like a salamander, the fire spread wide and flames began to crawl, creeping, illuminating an entire wood.
paras.zh: 像蝾螈般，火蔓延开来，焰苗开始爬行、蔓延，照亮整片树林。

paras.en: First a twig, then a branch, then a tree.
paras.zh: 先是细枝，再是粗枝，然后是一棵树。

paras.en: A tree, then a forest, then a world.
paras.zh: 一棵树，然后一片森林，然后一个世界。

paras.en: Smoke and white-hot heat wrapped around the trees, twin ribbons that tightened and obscured.
paras.zh: 烟与白热的灼烫裹住树木，像两条束紧、遮蔽一切的丝带。

paras.en: That tightened and choked.
paras.zh: 越束越紧，令人窒息。

paras.en: Screams rose, and the whole forest vanished in a plume of thick smoke, and then…A shift.
paras.zh: 尖叫四起，整片森林在一股浓烟中消失，接着……一阵变幻。

paras.en: Anna dreamed.
paras.zh: 安娜做了个梦。

paras.en: Back into the void, and this time, the darkness moved.
paras.zh: 回到虚空，这一次，黑暗动了起来。

paras.en: It slipped and slid, a rough whisper scraping against her ear.
paras.zh: 它滑来滑去，粗糙的低语擦过她的耳畔。

paras.en: The darkness was not dark at all, but a never-ending desert of black sand.
paras.zh: 那黑暗根本不是黑，而是一片无边无际的黑沙荒漠。

paras.en: Sand filled her ears, her eyes, her nose, her mouth.
paras.zh: 沙子灌满她的耳、她的眼、她的鼻、她的嘴。

paras.en: She waded through, unable to see, unable to breathe, unable to know, and then…A shift.
paras.zh: 她在其中跋涉，看不见、喘不上、无从知晓，接着……一阵变幻。

paras.en: Anna dreamed.
paras.zh: 安娜做了个梦。

paras.en: No longer rough, the sand melted, turning to liquid, growing heavy, and falling in a soft black rain to a great crater, until it brimmed, overflowing.
paras.zh: 沙不再粗糙，化作液体，变重，如温柔的黑雨落进巨大的坑洞，直到满溢。

paras.en: The dark was an ocean now.
paras.zh: 黑暗如今成了一片海洋。

paras.en: Each slap of a wave left a swirling froth of white, brilliant against black water.
paras.zh: 每一次浪拍，都留下打着旋的白色泡沫，在黑水上分外耀眼。

paras.en: Brilliant against the dripping mane of a midnight horse.
paras.zh: 也耀眼地映着一匹午夜之马滴落的水鬃。

paras.en: The stallion reared from the Dark Sea’s deepest depths, screaming its freedom as it shrugged off the ocean’s weight and galloped across the waves toward her.
paras.zh: 那雄马从暗海最深处直立而起，嘶鸣着它的自由，甩脱海洋的重压，踏浪朝她奔来。

paras.en: Its heavy hooves drummed a rhythm that took over her heart, and then it bucked, and it was not Anna whom the horse chased, but Elsa.
paras.zh: 沉重的蹄声敲出占据她心房的节拍，接着它扬蹄腾跃，追赶的却不是安娜，而是艾莎。

paras.en: Its eyes glowed white as it bore down on her sister… Anna woke up.
paras.zh: 它双眼泛白，向妹妹逼去……安娜醒了。

paras.en: Her heart slammed against her chest as though she’d been running, and the questions scrolled through her mind: Was it happening again?
paras.zh: 她的心像刚跑过般撞着胸口，一连串疑问在脑中滚过：又来了吗？

paras.en: Was the nightmare back?
paras.zh: 噩梦回来了吗？

paras.en: Anna felt a bit disoriented.
paras.zh: 安娜有些恍惚。

paras.en: It took her a moment to register that she wasn’t in her own room.
paras.zh: 她过了一会儿才意识到，自己不在自己房里。

paras.en: She was in their parents’ room.
paras.zh: 她在父母的房间里。

paras.en: That was right.
paras.zh: 对了。

paras.en: She and Elsa had fallen asleep together after Anna sang one of their mother’s old lullabies, a favorite about a secret river.
paras.zh: 她和艾莎是一起睡着的——安娜唱了一首母亲的老摇篮曲，那是首关于一条秘密河流的、她们最爱的歌。

paras.en: Elsa had seemed distracted and pensive during the night’s game of charades, so Anna had sung to bring a bit of lightness back into Elsa’s heart.
paras.zh: 夜里玩猜字谜时，艾莎显得心不在焉、若有所思，于是安娜唱起歌，想把一点轻盈带回艾莎心里。

paras.en: Anna stared up at the frothy canopy of the bed, and then glanced away.
paras.zh: 安娜仰望着床篷上如浪花般的帐顶，又移开目光。

paras.en: It looked too much like the white sea-foam that the rippling stallion had spat out as it galloped toward her.
paras.zh: 那太像那匹涟漪般的雄马朝她奔来时吐出的白色海沫了。

paras.en: A water horse, she realized, reminding her of the statue outside the secret room.
paras.zh: 是一匹水马，她恍然，这让她想起密室外的那座雕像。

paras.en: Relief sighed though her.
paras.zh: 她长舒一口气。

paras.en: These were just normal nightmares, then.
paras.zh: 那么，这些只是普通的噩梦。

paras.en: No wolf.
paras.zh: 没有狼。

paras.en: The Nattmara was gone.
paras.zh: 纳特玛拉已经不在了。

paras.en: She had nothing to fear.
paras.zh: 她没什么好怕的。

paras.en: They were just a collection of images from the week’s events, from things around her home.
paras.zh: 它们只是这一周发生的事、家中周遭之物拼凑出的画面。

paras.en: There was no need to be afraid of her dreams, not anymore.
paras.zh: 不必再害怕自己的梦了。

paras.en: And with that thought, Anna’s eyes slowly began to close… And then they flew open.
paras.zh: 念头至此，安娜的眼缓缓合上……接着又猛地睁开。

paras.en: They had fallen asleep together.
paras.zh: 她们是一起睡着的。

paras.en: But Elsa was not there.
paras.zh: 可艾莎不在那儿。

paras.en: Elsa wasn’t leaving Anna behind….She wouldn’t do that again.
paras.zh: 艾莎不会把安娜丢下……她不会再来一次了。

paras.en: Right?
paras.zh: 对吧？

paras.en: Anna tried to keep calm.
paras.zh: 安娜努力保持镇定。

paras.en: Elsa had probably gotten up extra early to tackle the stacks of papers waiting for her.
paras.zh: 艾莎多半是特地早起，去对付等着她的那堆文件了。

paras.en: A breeze curled through the room, and Anna shivered.
paras.zh: 一阵微风在房里打着卷，安娜打了个寒颤。

paras.en: At least she knew why she was cold: the balcony door had somehow blown open while they had been asleep.
paras.zh: 至少她知道为什么冷了：阳台门不知怎么在他们睡着时吹开了。

paras.en: Slipping out of Elsa’s bed, Anna grabbed their mother’s scarf from where Elsa had draped it across an armchair.
paras.zh: 安娜溜下艾莎的床，从艾莎搭在扶手椅上的地方，抓起母亲的围巾。

paras.en: Wrapping it around her shoulders, Anna stepped toward the balcony doors.
paras.zh: 把围巾裹上肩，安娜朝阳台门走去。

paras.en: She expected to see what she always saw: the village ensconced in deep blue shadows, only punctured here and there by the orange flames of lanterns in the courtyard directly below.
paras.zh: 她料会看见平日所见：村庄深陷蓝影，只有下方庭院里灯笼的橙焰，这儿那儿戳破黑暗。

paras.en: But as she drew closer to the balcony, a strange feeling flitted through her.
paras.zh: 可她走近阳台时，一种异样的感觉掠过心头。

paras.en: An unease.
paras.zh: 不安。

paras.en: A sense.
paras.zh: 一种预感。

paras.en: Or, as Olaf might say nowadays, a “gut-wrenching trepidation.” She knew, in the way that maybe only a sister could know, that something was about to change forever.
paras.zh: 或者，用雪宝如今的话说，一种‘揪心的惶惧’。她以一种或许只有妹妹才能有的方式知道，有什么即将永远改变。

paras.en: And when Anna stepped out onto the balcony, she saw that it already had.
paras.zh: 当安娜踏出阳台，她看见改变已然发生。

paras.en: The night glittered—the air glittered—the world glittered—as a million ice crystals of what looked like frozen rain hung suspended, like diamonds or glass shards that had forgotten gravity existed.
paras.zh: 夜在闪——空气在闪——世界在闪——百万枚仿佛冻雨的冰晶悬在半空，像忘了重力存在的钻石或玻璃碎片。

paras.en: Beautiful and sparkling.
paras.zh: 美丽，璀璨。

paras.en: Fierce and deadly.
paras.zh: 凌厉，致命。

paras.en: Each crystal was razor-sharp, and each pointed in the same direction, toward a figure who stood far away, alone in the night. “Elsa?” Her sister stood in the twilight, the waves of the Arenfjord behind her.
paras.zh: 每枚冰晶都锋利如刃，且都指向同一方向——一个远远伫立、独处夜中的身影。“艾莎？”妹妹站在暮色里，身后是阿伦峡湾的波涛。

paras.en: And though it should have been impossible for Elsa to see Anna from such a great distance, Anna saw her sister shift—and lock eyes with her.
paras.zh: 尽管以那么远的距离，艾莎本不可能看见安娜，安娜却看见妹妹动了动——与她四目相对。

paras.en: A brilliant white light in the distance shattered the darkness, illuminating for a single breath the look of awe on Elsa’s face.
paras.zh: 远处一道耀眼的白光劈开黑暗，只一瞬，照亮了艾莎脸上惊愕的神情。

paras.en: And then the ice crystals began to fall.
paras.zh: 接着，冰晶开始坠落。

paras.en: Anna flung herself away from the balcony, dashing through the halls and down the stairs.
paras.zh: 安娜从阳台猛地退开，冲过走廊，奔下楼梯。

paras.en: Her feet thudded against the flagstones.
paras.zh: 她的脚重重踏在石板上。

paras.en: Reaching the bottom floor, Anna threw open the castle doors.
paras.zh: 到了底层，安娜一把推开城堡大门。

paras.en: She stared at the ice crystals still suspended in front of her. “What?” she asked herself.
paras.zh: 她盯着仍在面前悬着的冰晶。“什么？”她问自己。

paras.en: The ice crystals filled the night with an eerie whistle as they tore through the air, only to end with a shout as they splintered across the cobblestones at her feet, making Anna’s path to Elsa slippery and dangerous.
paras.zh: 冰晶划破空气，给夜填上一声诡异的呼啸，最终在脚下的鹅卵石上碎裂，伴着喊声，把安娜通往艾莎的路变得又滑又险。

paras.en: But when was it not?
paras.zh: 可哪时不是呢？

paras.en: And when had it ever mattered?
paras.zh: 又有哪时曾在乎过？

paras.en: Securing their mother’s scarf, she raced out into the streets to find Elsa.
paras.zh: 她系紧母亲的围巾，冲进街道去寻找艾莎。

paras.en: The wind tugged at Anna, it howled, and then—the lanterns blew out.
paras.zh: 风扯着安娜，呼啸着，接着——灯笼灭了。

paras.en: Something was wrong.
paras.zh: 有些不对劲。

paras.en: Anna passed villagers peering out of their suddenly dark homes.
paras.zh: 安娜经过一个个从骤然漆黑的家中探出头的村民。

paras.en: In the place where Arendelle’s flags always flew strong, they had gone deathly still.
paras.zh: 在阿伦黛尔旗帜总高高飘扬的地方，它们死一般地静止了。

paras.en: Darkness, once again.
paras.zh: 黑暗，再次降临。
